jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Coordinator supports the Program Management Office in the planning, tracking, and documentation of projects across PureTek Corporation’s pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. Working under the direction of the Program Office Manager, this position maintains project schedules, trackers, meeting records, and project documentation, and coordinates the logistics that keep projects moving — scheduling, material and equipment readiness, and follow-up on open action items. The Project Coordinator also provides on-floor support for line trials, solid dose pilot batch programs, and equipment qualification activities. This is a support role: the incumbent executes and maintains rather than sets project direction, and refers scope, schedule, and priority decisions to the Program Office Manager.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintains project schedules, task lists, and milestone trackers in Monday.com, updating status from input provided by project owners and functional departments.
* Schedules and coordinates project meetings; prepares agendas, records meeting minutes, and distributes action item logs with assigned owners and due dates.
* Follows up on open action items and outstanding deliverables, and reports status and aging items to the Program Office Manager.
* Maintains the PMO document repository, project files, and templates; confirms records are current, complete, correctly named, and retrievable.
* Processes change requests through the established change management workflow, including intake, routing for review, and documentation of approved changes.
* Escalates schedule slips, blocked tasks, and unresolved action items to the Program Office Manager in a timely manner.
* Coordinates with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to track the status of project-related documentation and approvals.
* Coordinates with Supply Chain, Planning, and Purchasing on the status of materials, components, and long lead-time items required for project activities.
* Assists the Program Office Manager with resource and capacity tracking by maintaining project loading and assignment records.
* Prepares meeting materials, presentation decks, and project summaries as directed.

**Technical Operations & R&D Support**
--------------------------------------

* Supports new component evaluations by scheduling trials, requesting samples and specifications from our sourcing team, and compiling evaluation findings into the established documentation format.
* Coordinates the logistics of line trials, including equipment and room availability, material staging, personnel scheduling, and data collection forms.
* Provides on-floor presence during line trials and Solid Dose Pilot Batch monitoring runs to record in-process observations and collect trial data.
* Assists R&D with the preparation of trial protocols, data collection forms, and trial summary reports.
* Attends Performance Qualification (PQ) activities during equipment and process onboarding; documents execution, logs open items, and notifies Quality of observed deviations.
* Maintains equipment onboarding trackers covering FAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ status and associated documentation.

**Qualifications Required**
---------------------------

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and directly related experience will be considered.
* 1–3 years of project coordination, administrative, planning, or manufacturing support experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including intermediate Excel (pivot tables, lookups, chart building); working familiarity with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent scheduling software.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with demonstrated ability to track many open items across concurrent projects without dropping follow-up.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write accurate meeting minutes and concise status summaries.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, including gowning requirements and extended periods standing on the production floor.
* Availability for occasional off-shift or weekend coverage during line trials and qualification activities.
* Ability to travel between PureTek facilities as required.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Exposure to GMP guidelines, controlled documentation practices, or change control.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Familiarity with solid dose operations (granulation, compression, coating, packaging) or personal care and liquid manufacturing.
* Familiarity with electronic quality management systems (MasterControl, ETQ, or equivalent) and ERP systems.
* CAPM certification or coursework toward a project management credential.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Follow-through and reliability on committed dates
* Organization, attention to detail, and documentation discipline
* Clear, concise communication across shop floor and office audiences
* Cross-functional cooperation and responsiveness
* Sound judgment on when to resolve independently and when to escalate
* Adaptability in a fast-paced, regulated environment

jobs.description:
**Position**: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)  
**Location**: Los Angeles CA.  
**Work Location**: In Office/on-site  
**Contract:** Long Term  
  
**Position Description:**  
The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Build Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community District.  
  
Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.  
  
The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established Build PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate.
* Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, Build PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification.

jobs.description:
* **Company Overview**

**Lux Builders & Remodeling Inc. is a family-owned general contractor founded in 2005. The company specializes in high-end residential remodeling, new construction, and design-build projects across the South Bay and Los Angeles, and manages each project from planning and budgeting through design and construction.**

* **Position Summary**

**The Design & Project Coordinator supports remodel and new construction projects from the first client inquiry to the final walkthrough. The position is primarily office-based, with regular visits to showrooms and job sites. The Coordinator manages client communication, design selections, material sourcing, project systems, and the company’s social media presence as well as general office administrative operations.**

**Responsibilities**

**Client Relations and Leads**

* **Respond to incoming calls and inquiries, and represent the company professionally**
* **Schedule consultations and follow up with prospective clients**
* **Accompany clients to showrooms and assist with finish and fixture selections**
* **Provide clients with regular project updates**

**Design and Sourcing**

* **Review plans and specifications to prepare materials and finishes lists for each project**
* **Source tile, plumbing fixtures, lighting, hardware, and appliances**
* **Prepare selection sheets, compare pricing and lead times, and track orders and deliveries**

**Systems and Technology**

* **Develop and maintain digital tools such as selection trackers, order logs, client updates, and lead follow-up workflows, using AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT**
* **Maintain organized project files and support daily office operations**

**Marketing and Social Media**

* **Produce, edit, and publish at least one video reel per week featuring projects in progress and completed work**
* **Maintain active company profiles on Instagram, Facebook, Houzz, and TikTok**

**Field Support**

* **Conduct site visits to verify that installed finishes and fixtures match the approved plans and selections**
* **Report problems to the foreman and help coordinate material deliveries**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* **Bachelor’s degree**
* **Minimum of 1 year of experience in residential construction, interior design, architecture, or a related field**
* **Proficiency in SketchUp**
* **Advanced, daily use of AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT, with examples of tools or workflows the candidate has built**
* **Ability to read blueprints, elevations, and finish schedules**
* **Strong construction math skills, including square footage, linear footage, material quantities with overage, and scale conversions**
* **Strong design sense and working knowledge of finishes, fixtures, and materials**
* **Professional, polished communication with high-end clients, both by phone and in person**
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
* **Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle**

**Preferred**

* **Proficiency in Revit**
* **Experience in sales, client service, or design consultation**
* **Video editing skills and a social media portfolio**

Pay: $30.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

* Interior Design: 1 year (Preferred)

jobs.title: Travel Study Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Provide programmatic, contract management, analytical, and student services support for the UCLA Travel Study Program. In collaboration with faculty, campus partners, and external providers, develop and administer new and existing Travel Study programs, assessing and overseeing academic opportunity, administrative viability, marketability, program needs, logistics, budgets that support all program costs, contracts negotiation and compliance, student enrollment, and program outcomes. Manage multiple Travel Study programs and projects simultaneously, coordinating timelines, deliverables, information, and resources across faculty, campus partners, vendors, and UCLA Study Abroad teams to ensure timely and effective program implementation. Provide relevant details in necessary format to UCLA Study Abroad Operations teams for approval from UCLA Purchasing, Accounting and Insurance and Risk Management. Analyze enrollment, revenue, expenses, evaluations, and other program data, department feedback, and make recommendations regarding program development, continuation, modification, or cancellation. Coordinate contracts and vendor relationships, student advising and recruitment, health and safety procedures, and responses to program and student issues and emergencies. Advise prospective and participating students on program selection, eligibility, academic requirements, financial considerations, and other individual needs or circumstances that may affect successful participation in Travel Study programs. Conduct complex administrative analysis requiring knowledge of University policies and procedures and national standards and best practices in study abroad.

  
**Salary & Compensation**
  
  
\*UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.
  
**Qualifications**  
  

* 1+ Years of demonstrated experience with travel planning and contract negotiations or equivalent (Required)

* 1. Demonstrated knowledge of the study abroad field, including study abroad program development, administration, student services, and current practices and expectations in the field. (Preferred)

* 2. Demonstrated program and project management skills, including the ability to organize and manage multiple complex programs, priorities, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment. (Required)

* 3. Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and assess complex administrative and programmatic issues, evaluate information and data, develop solutions, and make sound recommendations. (Preferred)

* 4. Demonstrated financial and quantitative skills, including the ability to develop and monitor budgets and analyze enrollment, revenue, expenses, statistical data, and other factors affecting program operations and viability. (Required)

* 5. Demonstrated experience with travel planning, vendor relationships, contract negotiation, and/or coordination of complex logistical arrangements. (Preferred)

* 6. Ability to interpret, apply, and clearly communicate complex policies, procedures, regulations, and administrative requirements to faculty, students, staff, external providers, and other stakeholders (Required)

* 7. Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and professional correspondence, reports, instructions, and presentations and effectively communicate information to individuals and groups. (Required)

* 8. Demonstrated interpersonal and advising skills to establish effective working relationships with students, faculty, staff, campus partners, and external providers from diverse backgrounds and to respond diplomatically and appropriately to sensitive, complex, or stressful situations. (Required)

* 9. Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and initiative, establish priorities, and complete assignments accurately and efficiently with minimal supervision while working collaboratively as part of a team (Preferred)

* 10. Demonstrated ability to maintain and analyze program and student data, produce accurate reports, and appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information in accordance with applicable policies and requirements. (Required)

* 11. Working knowledge of University administrative structures, policies, procedures, and business processes related to areas such as purchasing, contracting, risk management, financial administration, and student services (Preferred)

* 12. Ability to work outside standard business hours and travel as needed to support Travel Study programs and activities, and ability to work on campus in person, typically one to three days per week (Required)

  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications & Personal Affiliations**  
  

* Bachelor's Degree In education-related or career-counseling field, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience/training. (Required)

  
**Special Conditions for Employment**  
  

* Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.

* Live Scan Background Check: A Live Scan background check must be completed prior to the start of employment.

* Age Requirement: Candidate(s) must be 18 years or older to be eligible to be hired.

* CANRA: The position is designated as a mandatory reporter under CANRA. The employee must sign the "Statement Acknowledging Requirement to Report Child Abuse".

jobs.description:
Job description

Company and benefits

Social Impact & Sustainability

Job ID

41800

Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a **Flex Work** approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

The **Marketing** department creates passion and relevance for the "Dolby Difference" driving sell-in and sell-thru of Dolby enabled devices, services, content, and experiences across multiple constituents – partners, creators, consumers, and developers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Program Coordinator (Contract) to join our Dolby Creator Lab team, our initiative to help creatives advance the art of storytelling. The mission of the Dolby Creator Lab is to inspire and educate the next generation of content creators to bring their dreams to life, in Dolby. Our core values are to enable, inspire, educate, and amplify human stories from new voices that need to be heard.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support Dolby Creator Lab initiatives, including our weekly podcast, music and UGC programs, virtual and in-person events, grant programs, and partnerships.
* Responsibilities include scheduling podcast recording sessions across all categories, including film/tv, music, and gaming (including direct interface with important external business partners and internal stakeholders), managing digital assets, reviewing edits, writing program descriptions, and tracking all deliverables with Social, Digital, and external partners.
* Work cross-functionally with internal teams including Design, Copy, Social, PR, and Digital to develop, schedule, and release Creator Lab content across Dolby’s global channels, and with our external partners and vendors, supporting ongoing collaborations and project tracking.
* Coordinate and manage digital content for Creator Lab’s Dolby.com presence. Build and publish net new pages, and working with the digital team to roll out new features and functions.
* Prepare and coordinate internal and external communications, including newsletters, employee giveaways, presentation decks on Creator Lab initiatives and programs.
* Support the Sr. Manager of Programs and Content and Dolby Creator Lab Director with vendor, partner, and sponsorship contracting, onboarding, invoicing, expense reporting, and travel.
* Support the Sr. Manager of Programs and Content and Dolby Creator Lab Director on research projects related to program initiatives.
* Upcoming and always on initiatives and programs include but are not limited to Dolby Creator Talks Podcast, Dolby Creator Lab Grants, Film Festivals (Sundance, SXSW), CES, Dolby Creator Lab Short Film Program.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong written and verbal communications skills.
* Poise and comfort level with speaking to all levels of staff and management.
* Interest in consumer technology and/or the entertainment industry, including movies, music, and games.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Passionate, positive, and solution-oriented attitude.
* Photoshop, Excel, Word, Outlook, Smartsheet, Keynote, PowerPoint, Teams, and Slack proficiency.
* Ability to track projects and deliverables in Miro and Airtable. Familiarity with content management systems. (training available)
* Experience with in-person and virtual event support and production (video and photo shoots, film screenings, receptions, conferences and festivals).

**Duration**
------------

* 6 months

The hourly rate range for this position in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and the New York area is $50–$58/hour and may vary outside these locations. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, market demands, internal parity, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific range during the hiring process.

Girl Scouts of Greater Los Angeles (“GSGLA”) is the largest girl-serving nonprofit organization in the Los Angeles region. Our mission is to build girls of courage, confidence, and character, who make the world a better place. www.girlscoutsla.org.

Our core values of Integrity, Clarity of Purpose, Accountability and Respect represent how we behave on a day-to-day basis. These are the specific behaviors that are imperative and encouraged in our company culture.

**Position Summary**

The Coordinator, IT & Administration keeps IT and Administration work organized and moving. The role coordinates projects, manages department invoices and reconciliations, handles scheduling and meeting follow-up, and supports onsite technology needs across GSGLA locations. * Track software licenses, subscriptions, and renewals; assist with budget monitoring.
* Handle IT procurement, including equipment for new hires.
* Comply fully with Council financial policies and procedures.

**Scheduling & Communications (about 15–20%)**

* Schedule and coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and distribute notes and follow-ups.
* Serve as first point of contact for new-hire technology questions and support onboarding/offboarding.
* Help keep the SharePoint intranet and staff-facing IT instructions current.

**Onsite & Technology Support (about 10–15%)**

* Serve as the point of contact for IT & Admin needs when the Director is out of the office.

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Planner/Lists); comfortable using Copilot or other AI tools for notes and follow-up.

* Highly organized with excellent follow-through; confident holding others, including their manager, to agreed deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and good people skills with staff at all levels.

* Ability to spend time sitting, utilizing the computer, and standing and walking throughout the facilities.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel between GSGLA locations throughout the region.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds periodically.
* Flexibility to attend evening and/or weekend meetings and/or events.
* Able to perform this job safely, without endangering the health or safety of themself or others.

**Recommended Education, Training and Experience**

* At least 2–3 years of experience in IT, administrative, or project coordination roles.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience with invoices, purchase orders, expense reports, and reconciliations.

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The USC Caruso Catholic Center seeks a highly organized, detail-oriented, and technologically proficient Advancement & Development Coordinator to support fundraising, donor relations, communications, events, and development operations.

The ideal candidate is an excellent writer with strong technical skills and demonstrated experience in donor database management, gift processing, financial reconciliation, and fundraising reporting. This position requires someone who can maintain accurate advancement data, produce reliable reports, and support efficient fundraising operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Donor Relations & Communications**

* Prepare fundraising proposals, donor briefings, impact reports, and presentations.
* Draft and edit fundraising appeals, donor correspondence, and stewardship communications.
* Create and manage Mailchimp email campaigns, including audience segmentation and engagement tracking.

**Database Management & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate donor records in Raiser’s Edge, including gifts, pledges, constituent information, and donor interactions.
* Enter and process donations, ensuring accurate data transfer and coordination among Raiser’s Edge, QuickBooks, and Salesforce.
* Run and adapt Raiser’s Edge queries and reports to track fundraising performance, giving history, pledges, campaigns, and donor engagement
* Reconcile donor and gift information with financial records, identifying and resolving discrepancies
* Manage donor acknowledgments and maintain accurate gift records

**Advancement Events**

* Plan and manage donor cultivation and stewardship events, including receptions, lunches, and alumni gatherings.
* Create and manage event invitations, email campaigns, audience lists, and follow-up communications through Mailchimp.
* Track RSVPs and maintain accurate guest and attendance records.
* Coordinate event logistics, including catering, venues, vendors, and guest communications.
* Manage event budgets, expenses, and post-event follow-up.

**Requirements**
----------------

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* A practicing Catholic with a passion for the Center’s mission and a desire to help build a welcoming, faith-filled community at USC.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in university advancement, nonprofit fundraising, development operations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage donor databases, process and reconcile gifts, and generate accurate fundraising reports.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal skills, professionalism, initiative, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**PREFERRED:**

Strong technical proficiency or ability to learn quickly the following platforms:

* **Raiser’s Edge:** Manage donor records, gifts, and pledges; run queries and reports. Experience building custom queries is a plus.
* **Microsoft Excel:** Advanced spreadsheet skills, including data management, analysis, and reporting.
* **Mailchimp:** Manage email campaigns, event invitations, contact lists, audience segmentation, and engagement tracking.
* **AI Platforms:** Working knowledge of ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Canva, and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks and Salesforce.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

We seek a proactive, resourceful, and exceptionally detail-oriented professional who combines strong communication skills with technical expertise. A passion for the Catholic Center’s mission and values is essential.

**APPLY**

Email Cover Letter and Resume to our hiring manager at hiring@catholictrojan.org

**ABOUT THE USC CARUSO CATHOLIC CENTER**

USC Caruso Catholic Center is a vibrant Catholic parish and campus ministry serving the University of Southern California community. We are located across from USC. Our team spans campus ministry, worship, advancement, marketing, and operations, and we’re growing as we invest in the next chapter of the Center’s mission.

Through worship, faith formation, fellowship, and service, the Catholic Center fosters a vibrant Catholic community and prepares students for lives of faith, leadership, and service.

As a donor-supported ministry, the Catholic Center relies on the generosity of alumni, parents, parishioners, and friends to sustain its mission.

Wage Range

We consider a number of factors when making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience, training and other department needs.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes through the successful adoption and ongoing value realization of AvePoint solutions.

As a trusted advisor, you will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business goals, technology environment, and priorities, then translate those needs into actionable success plans. You will partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Technical Support, Services, and other internal teams to drive adoption, identify and mitigate risk, strengthen customer relationships, and position customers for long-term success.

This role is ideal for someone who is customer-obsessed, commercially aware, data-driven, and comfortable navigating both business and technical conversations with stakeholders ranging from administrators to executive leaders.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the customer success strategy for an assigned portfolio of customers, developing success plans tied to measurable business objectives, adoption milestones, and customer outcomes.
* Drive product adoption and value realization by helping customers understand, implement, and expand their use of AvePoint solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical teams, business leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Monitor customer health and engagement, using product adoption, customer sentiment, support history, engagement, and other customer data to identify opportunities and risks.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risk, creating clear action plans for customers showing signs of low adoption, disengagement, or dissatisfaction.
* Conduct Executive Business Reviews and strategic customer conversations that demonstrate realized value, measure progress against customer goals, and establish priorities for the next phase of the relationship.
* Partner with Sales on renewal readiness, ensuring customer value is clearly understood, risks are identified early, and key stakeholders are engaged well ahead of renewal.
* Identify growth and expansion opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and surfacing qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales teams.
* Maintain accurate customer records and success plans in AvePoint's customer systems, ensuring customer health, activity, risks, opportunities, and next steps are current and actionable.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources across Sales, Support, Services, Product, and other teams to remove customer barriers and drive successful outcomes.
* Develop expertise in AvePoint's platform and solutions, enabling credible conversations about how AvePoint can address customers' evolving governance, security, data management, and technology needs.
* Plan and conduct onsite customer engagements as appropriate to strengthen executive alignment and deepen understanding of customer priorities.

  

**OK, I'm interested… is this the job for me?**

We look for people who value agility, accountability, curiosity, passion, and teamwork. You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy building relationships, solving complex customer challenges, using data to guide decisions, and helping customers turn technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* 2+ years of experience in a technical consulting role such as technical account management or technical business analysis
* Strong customer satisfaction, customer service, adoption, and retention experience
* Excellent written/verbal communication, organization, presentation, and project management skills
* Ability to work individually and within a highly collaborative global team setting
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
* Strong experience in communicating with different stakeholders and decision makers, both internally and externally
* Expert at customer relationship management
* Advanced ability to understand business objectives through requirements gathering and analysis
* Impeccable organizational awareness skills

**Knowledge in the following technical areas are a plus:**

* Understanding of Microsoft SharePoint architecture, components, and configuration. Understand the differences between the SharePoint versions and Office 365 collaboration technologies
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, Active Directory, SMTP, and DHCP technologies
* Working technical knowledge of current software protocols and Internet standards
  

The Salary Range for this role is $83,000 - $125,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Paramount
jobs.description:
To thrive as a Sales Representative with Behr, you must be organized, approachable, professional, and be ready to manage every aspect of Behr-related business in five or more Home Depot stores in your area.

Our Territory Sales Representatives help us put our best foot forward, every single day. Daily, you will visit your stores and be the face of Behr. You’ll do sales, relationship-building, merchandising, ordering, and any problem solving required. With every task and interaction, you will leave someone with a positive impression of Behr and the knowledge that we genuinely want to help them do their work better.

As a Territory Sales Representative, your work hours will vary based on peak selling times. This could mean weekends, holidays, and shifts that can extend until 7pm. We work while the consumer shops!

**Here’s** **what a typical day looks like for a Sales Rep:**

* **Sa****les**. A proactive approach to selling that creates value for the customer will be very important for success.

* **Relationships**. The biggest and most important aspect of this job is building relationships. From Home Depot managers, Home Depot associates, other Behr reps, professional contractors, and residential customers in the stores… you will work with anyone to ensure Behr is able to help them with whatever project they’re working on.

* **Training**. You’ll train Home Depot associates, Behr team members, and even the public on Behr’s product line. From time to time, you may lead a class or demonstration in the store to show customers how to properly stain a deck, paint trim, or find the proper finish for different rooms in their house. You must be comfortable speaking to groups and able to communicate clearly so they get all the knowledge you can share.

* **Merchandising**. We want our paint chips, brochures, and products to be fully stocked and the area clean to create a vibrant and eye-catching display. Your merchandising skills will draw customers to our products. This will require occasional lifting of up to 75 lbs.

* **Ordering**. Keeping the stores stocked with colorants, point-of-purchase materials like samples and brochures, etc… that’s all part of your job. You will keep an eye on this inventory and order needed materials.

* **Travel**. You will travel between stores on a consistent and regular basis, making sure you spend adequate time at each location. You’ll use an app to facilitate the tracking of your mileage for reimbursement. Be ready to supply a copy of your license and insurance information upon offer to keep the pre-employment process running smoothly.

**Here’s** **what we offer you:**

* Competitive pay and bonus opportunities. Sell more gallons = more money!

* Accrue 15 paid days off your first year plus sick days.

* 401(k) retirement plan with 4% match. Annual retirement profit sharing payments

* Competitive health plans for individuals and families.

* Check out behr.com/careers to view a comprehensive list of our benefits and perks.

* A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required for all roles at Behr Paint Company.

At Behr Paint, we strive to have all team members bring their best selves and their unique perspectives every day.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable, unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

**The Role**

Valar is hiring across all orgs and the volume keeps climbing. We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to carry live searches from week one: scheduling interviews, hosting candidates onsite, managing travel, and keeping Greenhouse accurate across every pipeline in flight. Our coordination team already runs a working process, built for a smaller company than the one we're becoming. You'll step into it, then improve it. Competing calendars, late cancellations, and shifting priorities are the normal condition here, and you'll be trusted to resolve most of it yourself. Candidates meet Valar through you first.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own interview scheduling across teams, time zones, and sites, including the multi-panel days.
* Host candidates onsite and run the day so interviewers and candidates always know where they stand.
* Coordinate candidate travel and review the expenses
* Own Greenhouse data hygiene: stage accuracy, interview kits, scorecard completion, clean candidate records.
* Close the gap between offer accepted and first day: background checks, paperwork, and the handoff to People Operations.
* Resolve scheduling conflicts on your own judgment, bringing recruiters and hiring managers the tradeoff and your recommendation rather than the raw problem.
* Keep pipelines moving with recruiters and hiring managers, flagging stalled candidates and interviewer bottlenecks before a search goes cold.
* Learn what we build and who we hire well enough to answer a candidate's questions yourself.
* Improve the coordination process as you learn it: bring the problem, the proposed fix, then the implementation.
* Pitch in on whatever hiring needs most that week, no matter the title on it, no task here is too small when a candidate or a deadline is on the line.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA - 5 days onsite

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Role:

**About the Role**

Great marketing is more than a compelling message. It's about reaching the right people, at the right time, with solutions that make a difference in their lives.

At Southland Credit Union, we're looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager who can turn big ideas into meaningful results. In this role, you'll help shape how we attract new Members, strengthen existing relationships, and connect people with financial products and services that support their goals.

Working closely with the VP of Marketing, you'll play a key role in shaping campaign strategy and driving initiatives from initial concept through execution and performance evaluation. This is a role for someone who can see the bigger picture, recognize opportunities, bring forward recommendations, and take ownership of turning strategy into measurable results.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Turning Marketing Strategy Into Action**

Every successful campaign starts with understanding who you're trying to reach, what matters to them, and what you want to accomplish. As the Integrated Marketing Manager, you'll translate organizational priorities into thoughtful marketing strategies that connect the right audiences with the right messages.

You won't simply be executing campaigns that have already been defined. You'll help determine the approach—identifying opportunities, understanding target audiences, shaping messaging, selecting the right channels, and establishing how success will be measured.

You'll lead integrated campaigns across digital advertising, email, websites, social media, direct mail, Financial Center communications, and other marketing channels. By bringing together creative development, compelling storytelling, digital marketing, and audience insights, you'll ensure each campaign delivers a cohesive experience and supports Southland's broader business objectives.

You'll also look for ways to make marketing more relevant and effective through audience segmentation, personalization, testing, and optimization. Your ability to connect business priorities with Member insights and marketing performance will help guide decisions and shape stronger campaigns.

**Driving Campaigns and Cross-Functional Partnerships**

Strong marketing requires more than a good strategy. It takes someone who can bring the right people together, influence direction, and move initiatives forward.

You'll serve as a key Marketing partner to departments including Lending, Operations, Digital Banking, and Member Experience. By understanding their priorities and challenges, you'll identify opportunities to translate business needs into marketing initiatives that attract new Members, encourage product adoption, deepen existing relationships, and support Member engagement.

You'll lead campaign planning and coordination across internal teams, marketing specialists, and external vendors. From developing campaign briefs and providing creative direction to managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder feedback, you'll maintain ownership of the work while keeping everyone aligned on the desired outcomes.

This role calls for someone who can confidently make recommendations, exercise sound judgment, and address challenges without waiting for direction at every step. When priorities shift or obstacles arise, you'll identify solutions, manage competing demands, and keep initiatives moving forward.

**Measuring Results and Improving Performance**

Great marketing doesn't end when a campaign launches. Understanding what worked, what didn't, and where opportunities exist is just as important as the strategy behind it.

You'll monitor campaign performance against established objectives and key performance indicators, using marketing analytics, behavioral data, and audience insights to evaluate effectiveness. You'll translate those findings into meaningful recommendations that help improve acquisition, Member engagement, product adoption, and retention.

You'll also oversee campaign budgets, monitor expenditures, and recommend adjustments based on performance and business priorities. Working with Compliance and other stakeholders, you'll coordinate required reviews and approvals to ensure campaigns align with Southland's brand standards, messaging guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Success means serving as a trusted marketing partner who can independently lead initiatives, influence campaign direction, anticipate challenges, and deliver results. You'll know how to balance the bigger strategic picture with the details required to bring each campaign to life, while continuously looking for ways to improve performance and strengthen Member relationships.

Knowledge and Skills:

**What Helps You Succeed**

**Experience**

* Five or more years of progressive marketing experience, including demonstrated responsibility for developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Proven ability to independently lead complex, multichannel marketing initiatives from planning through execution and performance evaluation.
* Strong copywriting, editing, and storytelling skills, with experience developing clear, compelling marketing content across digital and traditional channels.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple project timelines, and driving accountability without direct supervisory authority.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, customer acquisition, lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, and campaign performance measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret marketing performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Experience presenting recommendations and collaborating with stakeholders at various organizational levels.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Design, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Visual Communications, or a related field preferred.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Hi! We’re AntiSocial, a social-first digital marketing agency powered by people who love to create. Our work spans industries and disciplines, from conceptual campaigns and strategic media plans to creator partnerships, influencer strategies, and content production for leading brands around the world. As part of the Thinkingbox family, we bring creativity, collaboration, and innovation to everything we do. At AntiSocial, you’ll join a diverse and talented team that delivers bold campaigns and innovative solutions for some of the world’s top brands. Our culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and connection. Whether it’s brainstorming with colleagues, hanging out with our office dogs, or enjoying monthly events, we keep our work environment vibrant, inclusive, and fun.

**The Opportunity**  
We’re looking for a Community Manager to join our team. You'll be the voice behind some exciting gaming and entertainment brands, building engaged online communities and creating meaningful connections with passionate audiences.

The ideal candidate is social-obsessed, culturally curious, and always plugged into what's happening online. You understand internet culture, know how to adapt your tone of voice for different audiences, and have a knack for turning everyday interactions into opportunities for engagement. You'll work closely with our social, creative, and strategy teams to bring brands to life through authentic conversations, proactive engagement, and community insights.

This role is also a great opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in social strategy, with the chance to support social listening, audience insights, trend research, and campaign planning, and grow into a Social Strategist role over time.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Manage day-to-day community engagement across social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube, Reddit, and Discord.
* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, mentions, and conversations in a timely, thoughtful, and brand-appropriate way.
* Develop and maintain authentic brand voices, adapting tone and messaging across different clients and audiences.
* Build relationships with passionate fan communities, creators, influencers, and brand advocates through meaningful engagement.

* 2+ years of experience in community management, social media, or a related digital marketing role, ideally within an agency environment.
* A strong understanding of social media platforms, online communities, and how audiences engage with brands.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to write engaging, clever, and on-brand responses.
* A natural ability to adapt your tone of voice across different brands, audiences, and platforms.
* A genuine passion for internet culture, gaming, entertainment, fandom, and what's happening online.
* An understanding of what makes fan-driven communities tick and how brands can participate in those spaces authentically.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients and communities at once.
* Experience using social media management and listening tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Brandwatch, or similar platforms.
* Good judgment when handling sensitive conversations, customer concerns, or potential brand issues.
* A proactive, collaborative mindset and the ability to spot opportunities without always being asked.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, creative agency environment where priorities can shift quickly.

### **Bonus Points!**

* Experience playing Magic: The Gathering is a plus.
* Experience working with gaming, entertainment, fantasy, or pop culture brands.
* An interest in trading card games, tabletop gaming, fantasy worlds, collectibles, or gaming communities.
* Familiarity with fan-driven marketing, product launches, or community-focused campaigns.
* A passion for storytelling, world-building, and creating work that resonates with dedicated audiences.

* Flexible time off, including paid vacation and sick days
* Consistent culture and team-building events
* Employee recognition and incentive programs
* Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
* Office lunches
* Branded company swag
* Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non-profit outreaches
* Dog-friendly offices

* Flex work and travel options
* Comprehensive extended health benefits

jobs.title: Sales Representative, Tech Performance - Texas
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:  
Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE:  
The Tech Performance Sales Representative mission is to build positive and lasting relationships with current and future retail partners, consumers, and the performance community with a focus on Running, Golf, and Pickleball in the Texas market. As a key function of the brand, this role works closely with the Sports Marketing, Product, Marketing and their collective Sales teams to bring our brand to life at retail. We are looking for a driven, energetic and sports- passionate sales representative to join our growing Sports Performance team. We are looking for someone who is ready to hustle, build relationships and grow the Skechers brand across one of the most exciting sports markets in the country.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Primary Categories- Core Focus

* Drive Sales and market share growth across Skechers Running, Golf and Pickleball categories within your assigned Texas territory.
* Build and manage relationships with key retail accounts, run specialty dealers, golf-tennis pro shops, and sporting goods retailers.
* Execute seasonal sell-in meetings, present product lines, and close orders that meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and develop new account opportunities and expand distribution and brand presence in the territory.

Secondary Categories- Supporting Role

* Support sales efforts across Tennis, Walking, Soccer and Basketball categories to deliver a full Skechers portfolio to retail partners.

Brand and Field Activation

* Collaborate closely with regional tech reps to educate retail staff and athletes on Skechers product technologies, innovations and performance benefits.
* Partner with Sports Marketing team to activate brand initiatives, athlete appearances, grassroots events, and in-store experiences across the territory.
* Represent Skechers at trade shows, sporting events, clinics, and community activations throughout Texas.
* Champion brand storytelling and help bring the Skechers performance identify to life at the retail level.

Planning and Reporting

* Develop and manage a territory business plan aligned with regional and national sales strategies.
* Track account performance, sell-through date, and competitive insights.
* Manage seasonal order books, re-orders and product assortment recommendations for each account.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

* BA or BS degree in Business or equivalent combination of experience.
* 1+ years Marketing/Sales/Retail experience required, 2+ years preferred.
* Running, Golf, Sports or Athletic industry experience highly preferred.
* Work experience within the running or golf community.

* Basic knowledge of retail math, inventory management, product merchandising and retail selling skills.
* Experienced self-starter with strong negotiation skills and entrepreneurial characteristics.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with strong time management abilities.
* Demonstrated aptitude for problem-solving and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Valid driver's license and clear driving record.
* Ability to lift and carry samples, sample bags, and marketing materials.
* Travel required (approximately 80%).
* You must be willing to live within an agreed upon radius of the territory you support.
* Highly motivated with a hardworking attitude and strong interpersonal skills.
* Works well independently, as well as within a team.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand the sport of running and empathize with runners to develop authentic relationships at retail and the running community at large.
* Ability to strategically use an annual budget that benefits the territory and brand.

The pay range for this position is $105,000-$110,000/yr USD.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law.

**Reasonable Accommodation**  
Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com.  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions.

**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

**The Role:**  
  
You're an ideal candidate if you're hungry and eager to help grow the AWS practice at Tech Holding. We want someone who has experience or is excited to work in a startup-like environment. This is not the role for you if you've only worked inside a structured system where every process is laid out for you. We're looking for someone who wants to grow and expects to move into an AE role.

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) builds qualified pipeline for Tech Holding's AWS practice. You will prospect into startup, SMB and enterprise companies, work alongside AWS sellers to find co-sell opportunities, and book intro and discovery meetings for our Account Executives and Solutions Architects.

* **Reports to:** AWS Sales and Practice Lead
* **Career path:** A defined path to Account Executive in 18 to 24 months for consistent performers

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Outbound prospecting*

* Run multi-channel outbound (phone, email, LinkedIn) into target accounts and personas: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, IT Directors, founders and operations leaders
* Build and work account lists around plays we run today: VMware to AWS migration, data center exits, AI and generative AI roadmaps, Amazon Connect contact center modernization, and AWS Marketplace listings for ISVs
* Research each account before outreach and tie the message to a real business problem, not a product pitch
* Respond to and qualify inbound leads from the website, campaigns and events within one business day

*AWS co-sell*

* Build working relationships with AWS Account Managers, Partner Development Managers and Partner Sales Managers
* Map AWS seller territories to our target accounts and run joint outreach on priority accounts
* Register qualified opportunities in AWS Partner Central (ACE) and keep them updated so Tech Holding earns AWS co-sell credit
* Spot customers who qualify for AWS funding programs (migration, modernization and AI assessments) and flag them to the Account Executive

*Qualification and handoff*

* Run first-call discovery to confirm business need, timeline, decision process and budget authority
* Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Solutions Architects, with clear notes on what the prospect cares about
* Log every activity, contact and opportunity in the CRM so pipeline data is accurate

*Events and marketing support*

* Drive registrations and follow-up for AWS co-hosted events, executive dinners and roundtables
* Give feedback to marketing on which messages, lists and plays are landing
* Post and engage on LinkedIn to build a professional presence in the AWS ecosystem

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2 years in a quota-carrying B2B SDR, BDR or inside sales role, with a record of hitting or beating quota. If you have less than 2 years in sales but relevant experience in a related role, we still encourage you to apply.
* Experience selling technology or IT services (cloud, SaaS, managed services or consulting)
* Working knowledge of core AWS cloud concepts: compute, storage, databases, migration and why companies move to the cloud
* Strong writing. You can turn a technical benefit into a short, clear message a busy executive will answer
* Comfort on the phone and with cold outreach, and the resilience to handle objections and rejection
* Daily CRM discipline (Salesforce or HubSpot)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner within the first 90 days (Tech Holding covers the exam)

**Nice to have:**

* Prior work at an AWS consulting partner, AWS reseller, MSP or at AWS itself
* Experience with AWS Partner Central (ACE) and the AWS co-sell process
* Familiarity with AWS funding and partner programs (MAP, POCs, assessments)
* AWS AI Practitioner certification, or a working grasp of generative AI use cases
* Hands-on with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Outreach or Salesloft
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience

**Traits we hire for:**

* Owns the number without being told
* Works well with engineers and Solutions Architects

**Location:**

**Travel:**

* 1 to 2 trips per quarter, plus regional AWS offices, customer meetings, AWS Summits and partner events

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Experience using ERP, MRP, or production planning systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

We are a Bay Area residential construction and development company specializing in luxury custom homes, new construction, and high-end residential projects.

We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive **Construction Project Coordinator / Assistant** to support our day-to-day construction activities, project management, material sourcing, and design coordination.

This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys being out in the field, visiting different locations, solving problems, and getting things done.

Key Responsibilities

**Jobsite Visits & Coordination**

* Visit residential construction sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Take progress photos, check project status, and provide updates.
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors as directed.
* Follow up on pending work, material requirements, and deliveries.
* Assist with project inspections and scheduling.

**Material Sourcing & Purchasing**

* Visit Home Depot, Lowe's, building supply stores, kitchen cabinet showrooms, tile stores, lighting stores, and other vendors.
* Research product options, pricing, specifications, and availability.
* Collect material samples, quotations, and product information.
* Pick up and deliver small materials and samples as needed.
* Coordinate orders, pickups, and deliveries.

**City Permits & Administrative Support**

* Visit city planning and building departments as required.
* Assist with submitting, collecting, and following up on permit documents under company direction.
* Coordinate with city staff regarding permit status, corrections, and inspections.
* Maintain organized project records, documents, and correspondence.

**Design & Project Support**

* Assist with sourcing interior finishes, lighting, flooring, cabinetry, plumbing fixtures, and other construction materials.
* Help compare product specifications, pricing, and vendor quotations.
* Communicate with designers, architects, suppliers, and contractors.
* Track project tasks, deadlines, purchases, and outstanding items.
* Perform other construction-related coordination and administrative tasks.

Requirements

* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel independently throughout the Bay Area.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent communication and follow-up abilities.
* Comfortable visiting active construction sites, city offices, and suppliers.
* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently.
* Basic computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, and document management.
* Detail-oriented, responsible, and willing to learn.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

* Background or education in construction management, architecture, interior design, civil engineering, or a related field.
* Familiarity with residential construction, construction materials, and building plans.
* Experience with purchasing, vendor coordination, or building permits.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Bluebeam, SketchUp, or other construction/design software is a plus.

**Recent graduates and motivated entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply.**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on luxury residential construction projects.
* Hands-on exposure to construction, architecture, and interior design.
* Direct involvement in residential development projects from planning through completion.
* Opportunity to grow into a larger project coordination or management role.
* Reimbursement for authorized business driving expenses.

Applicants should confirm their ability to travel regularly to different Bay Area locations.

Pay: $26.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Facilities Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Role description**

**Facilities Project Coordinator**

**The Role**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Project Coordinator to support the Facilities Project Management organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating facilities projects, managing procurement and financial processes, maintaining project documentation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and closure.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide project coordination and administrative support to the Facilities Project Management team.
* Manage assigned Facilities Service Requests (FSRs) from initiation through completion.
* Coordinate activities between business stakeholders, facilities teams, vendors, and other internal departments.
* Support Facilities project planning, execution, tracking, and reporting activities.
* Create, maintain, and track purchase requisitions, shopping carts, purchase orders, and related procurement documentation.
* Assist with project budgeting, financial tracking, reporting, and project financial closeout activities.
* Maintain project records, documentation, and document control processes to ensure compliance and audit readiness.
* Support SRM workflow management, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop presentations, project updates, reports, and executive-level communication materials.
* Prepare project status reports and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support operational and project-related activities as required by the Facilities organization.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

**What You Need**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Facilities Management, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or 8+ years of equivalent professional experience.
* Experience supporting facilities, construction, real estate, workplace services, or capital projects.
* Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing purchase orders, purchase requisitions, procurement, and vendor-related processes.
* Experience with project financial tracking, reporting, and project closeout activities.
* Strong knowledge of document control and records management practices.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Microsoft Project.
* Experience working with SAP, SRM, or similar ERP/procurement systems.
* Excellent verbal, written, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting facilities projects in semiconductor, manufacturing, technology, or corporate campus environments.
* PMP, CAPM, Facilities Management, or Project Management certification is a plus.
* Experience with capital project administration, project controls, or PMO functions.
* Knowledge of facilities operations, maintenance, workplace services, or corporate real estate processes.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Administrative Coordinator with the Center for Judicial Education and Resources.

The Administrative Coordinator position schedules and performs project management and logistical tasks required to deliver education programs and products for judges, court managers and court personnel. Staff work directly in support of faculty and collaborate with attorneys and education developers responsible for the training and recruitment of faculty and creation of course content. They coordinate the work performed by staff providing A/V Support Services, Distance Education/Media Production, meeting planning and contracting, course and program registration, printing, and mailing, and provide program management for live programs, supporting faculty and working with local site personnel. Staff work independently on more than one assigned program or product at a time and are responsible for coordinating the implementation of a variety of delivery mechanisms including but not limited to the following: in-person conferences, statewide institutes, regional education courses, local training courses, webinars, online videos, podcasts, and videoconferences.

This position is responsible for providing the full range of administrative coordination and project management duties required to deliver multiple education programs currently planned and approved by the Judicial Council as part of the Judicial Branch Education Plans. In order to ensure the work of the office is completed within budget and on time, assignments will be flexibly rotated, therefore, this position is expected to be capable of performing all coordinator duties.

**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish, monitor and coordinate program timeline.
* Ensure that critical program milestones are completed as required based on standard, pre-established guidelines.
* Monitor program budget. Establish program budget based on prefixed guidelines set by department supervisor and manager; monitor expenditures and notify management if/when costs will exceed budget allotment.
* Communicate with stakeholders in program development and delivery.
* Provide Faculty Support.
* Prepare chart of program faculty for use on registration website and in confirmations.
* Communicate with faculty on deliverables due per established program timeline, assist with registration and lodging/travel needs.
* Coordinate faculty and participant registration.
* Coordinate site selection and logistics.
* Collaborate with Conference Services on development of RFP, determination of evaluation criteria, evaluate RFP responses, and ultimate site selection.
* Manage materials preparation and distribution.
* Obtain and maintain course materials from faculty.
* Coordinate program publicity.
* Invoice processing.

**Qualifications**
------------------

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
  
Three (3) years of administrative support experience, including some experience in area(s) of assignment (such as accounting, writing/editing, database/spreadsheets, direct support to upper
  
management, etc.).

OR

Associate’s degree, preferably in area(s) of assignment, and one (1) year of administrative support experience, including some experience in area(s) of assignment (such as accounting, writing/editing,database/spreadsheets, direct support to upper management, etc.). Additional directly related experience and/or education may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.

OR

One (1) year as an Administrative Specialist, Facilities Specialist, or Fiscal Services Spec
