At Abode, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths.

**Housing Ends Homelessness**

**Our Mission:**

Abode works to end homelessness by assisting low-income, unhoused people, including those with special needs, to secure stable, supportive housing; and to be advocates for the removal of the causes of homelessness.

**Our Values:**

* Start with Dignity
* Take Smart Risks

* Spark each other’s strengths

**About The Role:**

This position assists with procurement processes, vendor onboarding, and maintenance of vendor and procurement records. The role works closely with internal departments and external vendors to support efficient purchasing operations and maintain positive vendor relationships. This position serves as a key resource for vendor coordination, purchasing administration, and operational support.

jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers.** Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
* **Drive activation yourself.** Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
* **Automate your own work.** Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
* **Spend your time on strategic conversations.** Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
* **Spot who is ready for more.** Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
* **Build programs, not one-offs.** When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
* **Be the voice of your book.** Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

**Where your time goes as we automate**
---------------------------------------

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

* **Deeper with priority accounts.** Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
* **Quarterly launches.** Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
* **Events.** Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
* **New signups and scaled partnerships.** Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
* Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around
* Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly
* Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track
* Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization
* Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win
* Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it
* Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely

**Strong candidates may also**
------------------------------

* Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup
* Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types
* Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts
* Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations
* Understand how nonprofits

jobs.title: Manager, SMB Account Management (Partner Referred Business)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.
* Ability to research accounts and understand buyer personas and decision-making structures.
* Curiosity about how data platforms and AI work, and the drive to learn the technology well enough to discuss it with an engineer.
* Strong client-facing presence and clear, concise writing.
* Bonus: Experience in or selling into healthcare, life sciences, financial services or insurance.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

This role is designed for BDRs who build their own pipeline today and are growing toward owning accounts and closing deals.

* You'd rather build your own target list than wait for inbound leads.
* You know why you're calling an account, and who owns the problem, before you pick up the phone.
* You're curious about how data and AI work, and you're not shy about asking an engineer to explain it.
* You take rejection in stride and make the next call just as sharp.

**Why Climb**
=============

* **Learn from the builders.** Work directly with founders and senior architects from your first week.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path to Account Executive, with a promotion review at 12 months tied to sourced pipeline and conversion.
* **Where enterprise AI happens.** A front-row view of the Databricks ecosystem and enterprise AI work.
* **Ground floor opportunity.** Join early alongside seasoned founders to help construct our growth playbook from day one.
* **Focus on outcomes.** We measure success by tangible business value and account expansion rather than arbitrary utilization metrics.
* **Senior engineering pods.** Work directly with elite technical teams and AI tooling, free from management bloat.
* **Compounding IP.** Every enterprise win builds reusable assets and technical blueprints back into our firm.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base plus uncapped variable
* MacBook Pro and swag kit so you can do your best work
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous holidays and flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Professional development budget including Databricks and cloud certifications
* Spot bonuses for relevant certifications
* Conference attendance and thought leadership opportunities
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with direct access to leadership
* Opportunity to shape a growing practice from the ground floor

Climb is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicant

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support for the WINGS+++ study in Orange County, NY, including coordinating recruitment and data collection, and will serve as liaison to community partners.

WINGS+++ is a NIDA-funded study (R61/R33) within the Social Intervention Group (SIG) at the Columbia University School of Social Work. The study is developing and testing an mHealth intervention with peer navigation for women in Orange County, New York, who use opioids or other drugs and who are affected by intimate partner violence (IPV) and trauma. The WINGS+++ intervention includes three self-paced mHealth sessions that screen for and address opioid and other substance use, IPV, and post-traumatic stress, combined with peer navigation that links women to medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and other substance use treatment, IPV, mental health, and social services. The study is conducted in close partnership with Orange County community organizations and includes a pilot trial. Under the direction of and reporting to the Project Director, the Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support to study research and administrative needs.

* Represent the study at community events and presentations to build awareness.

At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We're looking for a strategic, creative Content Marketing Manager who knows how to build content that builds community. This isn't a role for someone who just wants to write blogs. We're looking for someone who thinks deeply about how content shapes trust, drives discovery, and turns our audience into loyal advocates. You'll own our content strategy end-to-end: building the content engine that powers our external presence and supports teams across the company, leading brand campaigns, managing our Content Marketing Coordinator, and growing the community of pros who rely on Topline Pro to run and grow their businesses. If you love building systems as much as you love crafting content that resonates with real people, and you have the portfolio to prove it, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own content strategy and the editorial calendar across website, email, social, YouTube, and community.
* Build a repeatable content engine that powers our external presence and supports cross-functional teams (sales collateral, product marketing, enablement, etc).
* Manage the Content Marketing Coordinator, setting direction while they support production and editing.
* Own our content library (DAM) so every team can easily find and use the right assets.
* Lead one-off brand campaigns, from seasonal pushes to announcements.
* Create content that speaks authentically to home service pros (roofers, landscapers, painters, cleaners) and feels uniquely Topline Pro.
* Produce a range of formats: case studies, how-to guides, video scripts, testimonials, social friendly, and long-form.
* Collect interviews oof pros and turn their stories into content that builds trust and drives organic growth.
* Use content to fuel and support growth of an engaged pro community through forums, Facebook groups, newsletters, and events.
* Build a thought leadership program for Topline Pro and key internal voices via articles, podcasts, speaking, and LinkedIn.
* Cultivate relationships with pro advocates and industry experts who amplify our brand.
* Partner with Performance Marketing to create content for paid ads.
* Develop and own a repeatable playbook for distributing content that drives sales through SEO/GEO/AEO.
* Act as a player / coach with the ability to drive direction while being comfortable jumping in to execute when needed.
* Track performance, iterate fast, and scale what resonates.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4-5 years of experience in content marketing, brand storytelling, or editorial — with a portfolio that shows range and craft.
* Experience managing and developing at least one direct report, including setting priorities and giving clear creative direction.
* Proven ability to develop content strategy, not just execute on it — you know how to build a plan, and the systems behind it, from scratch.
* Experience leading integrated brand campaigns from concept through launch.
* Experience building or scaling a brand community — online groups, newsletters, ambassador or advocate programs, live or virtual events.
* Track record developing thought leadership content: executive ghostwriting, contributed articles, podcast or speaking program management, or LinkedIn brand building.
* Strong writing and editing skills across formats: short-form social, long-form guides, video scripts, email sequences.
* A genuine curiosity about and empathy for small business owners — you understand their world and speak their language.
* Comfortable using data to guide decisions: you track performance, form hypotheses, and adjust accordingly.
* Experience with SEO fundamentals and content distribution, plus familiarity with GEO/AEO.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, WordPress, or similar CMS, marketing automation, and digital asset management platforms.
* Collaborative instincts — you work well across brand, product, sales, and design.

**Who you are**
---------------

* A natural storyteller who can make complex or dry topics feel human and compelling.
* Someone who thinks in systems — you don't just create content, you build the machine that creates it.
* A leader who loves helping others grow — you give clear direction, great feedback, and room to run.
* Genuinely excited about community — you understand that great content is a conversation, not a broadcast, and you know how to build spaces where people want to show up.
* A natural thought leader developer — you can spot an interesting perspective in a founder or subject matter expert and shape it into something the industry actually wants to read.
* Self-directed and proactive; you bring ideas to the table and see them through.
* Energized by working closely with the people your content is about — you love getting on the phone with a Pro to find the real story.
* Motivated by impact and craft in equal measure.

**Hiring Process**
------------------

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Screen
* Portfolio Review
* Onsite
* Cofounder Screen

**What we offer**
-----------------

* $120K–$140K base salary range + equity
* Full Medical, Dental, and Vision Health Coverage
* Computer and workspace enhancements
* 401(k) plan (non-matching)
* Unlimited vacation, 9 company holidays including election day, and 1 personal volunteer day a year
* Company-paid Wellhub membership for fitness and wellness
* Dinner covered with Uber Eats + a stocked kitchen to keep you fueled
* Opportunity to own the content and community brand for a product that changes the lives of home service Pros

**Our Values**
--------------

* **No Bullsh\*t:** We create meaningful results for our customers and drive growth for our team — ensuring progress and impact are felt every day. Our focus is on delivering genuine value rather than superficial solutions.
* **Think Big, Learn Fast:** We move quickly, acting on data to uncover insights and solutions. We embrace risks, knowing every experiment fuels growth — even when it doesn't

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Hybrid: New York, NY (2-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square.

**SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS**
-------------------------------------------------------

Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.

As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections.

This is a category-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who wants to be on the ground floor of defining what success looks like for the companies adopting it.

**THE ROLE**
------------

As our Customer Success Manager, you will own the full post-sale relationship with MCP Manager customers: onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion. Our customers are typically companies of 200 to 1,000+ employees with active AI initiatives, and the people you work with day to day include VPs of AI, CTOs, IT operations leaders, and security teams. You will be the person who makes sure every one of them gets real, measurable value from putting their AI agent connections under governance.

You will work hand in hand with our Account Executives and Sales Engineer, and closely with our product, engineering, design, and marketing teams, inside a small, fast-moving group that operates much like a startup within Usercentrics. The role exists now because our customer base is growing and customer success deserves a dedicated owner. You will build the processes, health signals, and playbooks that let us scale it, and your insight from customers will directly shape what we build next.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

### **Onboarding and Adoption**

* Take over new customers at handoff after signing, building on the proof of concept and documented initial configuration they completed with our Account Executive and Sales Engineer, and guide them to broad rollout across their teams.
* Refine the success criteria agreed during the sales process into a success plan for each customer that ties their use of MCP Manager to the outcomes they care about, such as visibility, security, and cost control.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they are getting and where they can go next.
* Bring in our Sales Engineer when customers need deeper help with technical configuration or troubleshooting.

### **Support and Customer Health**

* Respond to inbound support requests through chat and email within our response-time targets.
* Route technical issues to our Sales Engineer, and to engineering when needed, with clear context and reproduction steps, and keep customers informed until they are resolved.
* Build and maintain a customer health score that draws on product usage, engagement, and support history.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and lead proactive outreach before small issues become churn.

### **Renewals, Expansion, and Billing**

* Own renewals for your book of customers and forecast them accurately.
* Identify expansion opportunities, such as additional teams, servers, or plan upgrades, and drive them to close in partnership with our Account Executives.
* Process plan upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in our billing and CRM systems so that customer records stay accurate.

### **Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and categorize customer feedback, and work with our Product Manager so that product and engineering can prioritize with real data.
* Close the loop with customers when features they requested ship or issues they reported are fixed.
* Build our customer advocacy program with marketing, collecting reviews, references, and case studies.
* Document repeatable processes and playbooks so that customer success can scale as we grow.

  
**Requirements**  

* You have 3 or more years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.
* You have owned renewals for a book of business and have a track record of retaining customers and growing accounts.
* You are technically fluent: you can explain how software products connect to each other, run a confident product walkthrough, and work through configuration questions alongside technical colleagues.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person with audiences ranging from hands-on administrators to CTOs and security leaders.
* You are highly organized and can manage many accounts, support requests, and internal projects at once without letting details slip.
* You use AI assistants and agents in your own work and are curious about how companies are adopting them.
* You are comfortable operating in an early-stage, category-creation environment where the playbook is still being written.
* Ideally, you have worked with customers in security, developer tools, data infrastructure, or AI software, or have hands-on familiarity with AI agents or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ideally, you have built customer health scoring, onboarding programs, or other customer success processes from scratch.

**About Norm**

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. **This Role**

As a key member of our marketing team, you'll build the campaign frameworks and cross-channel motions that connect our content, events, digital programs, and account-based efforts into cohesive journeys that move buyers from awareness to activation.

**90 Days**

* Establish a clear roadmap for Norm’s integrated campaigns
* Move the first priority program into execution with aligned stakeholders, ownership, timelines, and measurement.

Position Summary:

The Project Coordinator serves as an integral partner to our Project Managers, helping drive the day-to-day execution and coordination of projects from initiation through closeout. Reporting to the Administration/Coordination Group Leader, this highly collaborative role goes beyond traditional administrative support by taking ownership of project coordination activities, anticipating project needs, proactively resolving issues, and helping keep projects organized and on schedule. This is far more than a traditional administrative support role. Successful Project Coordinators become trusted business partners who help Project Managers increase capacity, improve project execution, and deliver exceptional client service.

  
  

Working closely with Project Managers, technical teams, clients, and project stakeholders, the Project Coordinator develops an understanding of each Project Manager’s workflow, communication style, and project priorities. As Project Coordinators gain experience and build trusted partnerships with their Project Managers, they assume increasing responsibility throughout the project lifecycle, becoming an extension of the Project Manager and creating the capacity for Project Managers to focus on technical leadership, client relationships, and strategic project delivery.

  
  

In this role you will join a dedicated professional team working to make a difference for our Federal Government Clients to:

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including itineraries, and logistical planning

Successful Project Coordinators are trusted partners who become an extension of their Project Managers. Rather than simply completing assigned tasks, they take ownership of project coordination activities, solve problems before they become obstacles, and contribute directly to the successful delivery of projects while creating additional capacity for Project Managers to focus on strategic and technical leadership.

Established in 2006, Interactive Government Holdings, Inc. (IGH) is a leading professional services and technology provider to the Federal Government. Our mission is to serve uniformed service members globally and their support systems locally. We utilize strategy, data science, and technology to make the programs we execute more efficient for the people our programs serve. IGH has a national and international program staff and a corporate headquarters located in Springfield, Virginia. We are proud of our ability to shape tomorrow while ensuring all active-duty personnel and reservists can carry out their critical missions and tasks today.

The National Guard Bureau (NGB) J1 Warrior Resilience and Fitness (WRF) Division requires a contracted team to manage the implementation of the National Guard (NG) Connectedness and Relationship Education (CARES) System, which includes the planning and execution of site visits, trainings and briefings across the nation, marketing campaigns, implementation and evaluation plans. The contracted team will work in coordination with the WRF Partnerships and Programs Branch and NG CARES Director.

**Job Description**

Interactive Government Holdings\\_ **(IGH)**\\_ is seeking qualified, trained and capable individual to serve as a Program Coordinator for the National Guard Connectedness and Relationship Education System.

NG CARES is an integrated, comprehensive, person-centered (eco)system which builds connections, increases protective factors, and promotes holistic health in support of Service Members and their Families throughout their career. These programs are critical to retention, readiness, and reduction of risky behaviors and emplacing protective environments in support of primary prevention strategies.

**Major responsibilities include (not all inclusive):**

Work with Program Manager to support the successful development, implementation and ongoing delivery and operations of specified programs. Support planning and coordination of a program and its activities. Support growth and program development.

Conduct or facilitate required and recommended training sessions and maintain files and records of training attendance, completion, and evaluation.

Develop and/or update any program associated instructor guides, participant handouts, and slides.

Manage communications through media relations, social media etc.

Help build positive relations within the team and external parties.

Keep updated records and create reports.

Meet timelines for administrative tasks, activities, and events.

Collect, assimilate, and showcase data to objectively support lines of effort and resource funding.

Maintain accurate data files and records to enable management to track the program’s progress/status.

Create/coordinate online registration for events that require registration. Online registration will be completed utilizing Army 365 and Microsoft Forms.

Attend all meetings, present trainings and reports as needed.

Coordinate with internal/external networks to obtain resources for events, manuals, supplies and materials.

Provide monthly documents and reports that are accurate and meet the suspense of the 1st of each month 98% of the time.

Due to the nature of the service, experience with the military is required. Experience can be gained through prior or current military service, member of a military family, or service as a military family volunteer.

Must possess and maintain a valid state issued driver’s license and a personally owned vehicle that can be utilized.

Work may vary. An uncommon tour of duty may be required. Flexibility with working schedule is mandatory because it impacts the ability to support and serve military.

Travel is anticipated for training. Travel will include regional and national to support mobile training team events.

**Skills / Certifications / Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree (preferred) in Leadership, Organizational Development, Talent Development, Adult Learning, Instructional Performance, Human Development, or related area and at least 3-5 years of experience in related field. A combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.

Exemplary skills in presenting/facilitating a wide variety of training to diverse audiences and the ability to motivate, communicate, and instruct/train others on facilitation.

Ability to work as part of a team, strong interpersonal skills.

Strong relationship building and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to work autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced, complex, multi-tasking virtual environment.

Strong command of Microsoft Office and ability to produce deliverables that carry a "stamp of excellence."

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch Monday - Friday (9 am – 3 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 20 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility

jobs.title: National Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Brayden, co-founder of Sola. We’re a venture-backed insurance startup based in Atlanta, and we’re hiring a National Account Manager to help grow our largest agency partnerships.

Most insurance companies have spent decades building complicated products and equally complicated ways to sell them. We’re doing things differently. We started with wind and hail coverage, using weather data to make claims faster, simpler, and more transparent. We’ve grown to 8-figure revenue and partnered with thousands of independent insurance agencies along the way.

Now we’re focused on going deeper with our largest partners. Some of the biggest opportunities at Sola aren’t new relationships. They’re the agencies already doing business with us that have hundreds of producers, multiple offices, and significant room to grow.

You’ll own a named portfolio of our most important national and regional accounts, with the opportunity to build relationships, expand our footprint, and influence how Sola grows across the country.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR Checklist**
-------------------

**✓** In person. West Midtown Atlanta office with skyline views, daily catering, and snacks

**✓** Startup environment. Small team, meaningful equity, and room to grow

**✓** Hypergrowth. 300%+ growth since May, 8-figure revenue

**✓** National accounts. Own a named portfolio of Sola’s largest agency partnerships

**✓** Real ownership. Build account strategies, expand relationships, and directly influence revenue

**✓** Flat structure. Work directly with our Director of Sales, Insurance, and leadership team

**About the Role**
------------------

* You’ll own and grow a defined portfolio of Sola’s largest national and regional agency partners. These are complex relationships that often span multiple offices, states, and decision-makers.
* Your job is to turn existing partnerships into meaningful, long-term revenue and hunt for new partnership opportunities with groups we are not yet partnered with. That means building relationships with agency leadership, identifying opportunities to expand into new offices and markets, and getting more producers actively selling Sola.
* You’ll work closely with our Sales and Insurance teams to develop account strategies, introduce new products, and help our partners grow alongside us.
* We’re looking for someone who understands how large agencies operate and knows how to turn a strong relationship into broader adoption across an organization.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own national accounts. Manage a named portfolio of large agency partners, with responsibility for revenue growth, retention, and overall account performance.
* Expand existing relationships. Identify opportunities to grow across additional offices, regions, and producer networks.
* Build strategic account plans. Develop growth strategies for each partner, set measurable goals, and execute against them.
* Drive adoption. Work with agency leadership and individual producers to make Sola a consistent part of their sales process.
* Navigate complex organizations. Build relationships with executives, regional leaders, territory managers, directors, and producers across multiple markets.
* Know your accounts. Understand agency operations, competitive offerings, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and solve problems.
* Work across teams. Partner with Sales, Insurance, and Product to introduce new programs, support agency needs, and grow existing business.

**Must-haves**

* 7+ years in sales, account management, insurance distribution, or a related field.
* Property and Casualty Insurance tenure
* Strategic account management. You’ve managed large, complex relationships and know how to grow revenue within existing accounts.
* Relationship builder.You’re comfortable working with senior executives and individual producers alike.
* Growth focused. You can identify opportunities, build a plan, and turn that plan into measurable results.
* Organized. You can manage multiple accounts, competing priorities, and long-term initiatives without losing track of the details.
* Strong communicator. You can influence decisions, navigate difficult conversations, and build trust with partners.
* In person. You’re excited to work with our team in West Midtown Atlanta.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Agency networks. Experience working with large independent agencies, national brokerages, aggregators, or agency networks.
* Multi-location growth. You’ve expanded accounts across multiple branches, territories, or states.

**Benefits**
------------

* Early stage equity
* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you, your spouse, and your children
* Daily catered lunch
* 401(k)
* Paid parking
* One Medical membership

jobs.title: Route Sales & Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Sales & Account Manager in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Benefits: Dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, mileage reimbursement, paid time off, vision insurance

Schedule: Monday to Friday; weekend availability as needed

Supplemental Pay: Commission pay, bonus pay

Ability to commute/relocate: Atlanta, GA

Experience: Route sales or territory sales: 1 year (Required); Account management: 1 year (Preferred); B2B sales or staffing industry: 1 year (Preferred)

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

Do you want to be part of an organization where you are valued, and your ideas and opinions have an impact? *Join the AssuranceAmerica team.*

For more than 25 years, AssuranceAmerica has provided superior property and casualty insurance products through contracted independent agents and directly to customers.

Our team succeeds through diversity of thought, experiences, skills, and backgrounds.

AssuranceAmerica is looking for a motivated, outgoing, and relationship-driven individual to join our team as an Inside Sales Representative at our Atlanta headquarters in Cobb Galleria.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking to launch or grow a career in sales and the insurance industry. We're looking for individuals who enjoy connecting with people, building relationships, and making a meaningful impact on business growth.

  

In this role, you'll work directly with Bud Stumbaugh, Co-Founder of AssuranceAmerica, to strengthen relationships with our existing insurance agency partners and help drive new business opportunities.

* Manage an assigned territory of approximately 300 non/low producing insurance agencies currently appointed with AssuranceAmerica.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a confident, engaging, energetic, effervescent personality.
* A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and self-motivated approach.
* Comfortable making outbound phone calls and initiating conversations.
* Natural ability to build rapport, establish trust, and develop professional relationships.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple agency relationships.
* Goal-oriented mindset with a desire to achieve results.
* Willingness to learn about the insurance industry and develop sales expertise.
* Bilingual candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
Previous sales or insurance experience is a plus but not required.  

  

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary with an opportunity to earn uncapped commission in performance-based bonuses
* Health insurance starting on day one
* Full-time position based in our Atlanta office at Cobb Galleria

Direct exposure to experienced company leadership  

  

**Why Join AssuranceAmerica?**

At AssuranceAmerica, relationships are at the heart of our business. Our success depends on strong partnerships with independent insurance agencies, and this position plays an important role in strengthening those connections.

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with company leadership, develop valuable sales and relationship-management skills, and contribute directly to the organization's growth.

If you're personable, ambitious, and enjoy connecting with people, we'd love to hear from you!

Interested candidates should email their resume directly to:

**Bud Stumbaugh**

**Email:** bstumbaugh@aainsco.com

**POSITION TITLE:** Community Manager

**DEPARTMENT:** Resident Services

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Manager

**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt

**JOB SUMMARY:**The Community Manager is a business leader who focuses on resident customer service and manages operations, leasing activity, renewals, collections, financial reporting, supplies, and communications for an assigned residential community.

**VALUES MODELED:** All employees are expected to find ways to bring our values to life every day by demonstrating: leadership, commitment, and integrity.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:** Resident feedback on quality and timeliness of resident services provided; resident turnover.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Manage day-to-day leasing operations.**
  + Inspect community on a regular basis and verifies the condition of vacant units in order to minimize rental arrears.
  + Manage daily community requirements and maintains long-range capital improvements planning.
  + Ensure all monies received are deposited and recorded on a daily basis and confirms proper bookkeeping procedures are followed.
  + Compile weekly/monthly community status reports.
  + Promptly respond to resident concerns, comments, and/or complaints.
  + Ensure that the proper move-in paperwork, keys, and remotes are prepared for a new resident.

  + Inspect make-ready apartments prior to move in.
  + Enforce occupancy policies and procedures.
  + Maintain and/or create a resident renewal program to encourage resident retention.
  + Create a sense of community at the community while maintaining the policy of non-fraternization.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.

  + Organize incoming and outgoing inspections and prepare inspection reports.
  + Implement preventive maintenance programs.
  + Oversee improvement projects.

  + Approve and submit invoices for payment in a timely manner.
  + Maintain accurate records of community transactions and submits on timely basis (i.e., rent rolls, delinquency reports, move-in/move-outs, etc.).
  + Complete variance reports and other weekly reports.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.

* **Manages and monitors rental collection.**
  + Ensure rent and other charges are collected timely and posted daily.

  + Immediately inform and refer any liability claims, legal complaints, or other violations to the Regional Manager and/or corporate office.
* **Manages community personnel.**
  + Hire, train, and evaluate community staff.
  + Create, mentor, and manage a cohesive community management team in accordance with policies.
  + Coordinate orientation and ongoing training programs for community staff.
  + Complete performance reviews for staff and makes recommendations for salary increases and/or advancement.
  + Direct and control all personnel and resources to ensure the community is properly maintained and meets owner objectives.
  + Manage time off for community management team and submit payroll for processing.
  + Ensure staff receives new hire safety orientation as well as annual safety training.
  + Coordinate with the Service Manager and attend monthly safety meetings and training for community staff; monitor the use of proper safety precautions on the community.
  + Follow company procedures and reports any workers' compensation issues and/or employee incidents immediately to the workers' compensation carrier, to management, and to Employee Service Department.
* **Manages, creates and monitors marketing activities.**
  + Understand the market and any other aspects of the sub-market that could impact occupancy and/or income of the community.
  + Assist with the creation of marketing surveys and understands marketing strategies to secure prospects.
  + Supervise the leasing team to ensure community is rented to the fullest capacity.
* **Perform other duties as assigned or requested to support community operations.**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Language Skills:** Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence.
* **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
* **Reasoning Ability:** Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
* **Computer Skills:** Strong computer skills in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel software. Experience in conducting Internet searches and using online calendars and databases.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:**

* Working knowledge of Entrata or other property management software.
* Must have reliable transportation, maintain auto insurance, and have a valid driver's license.
* Proven ability to market communities.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator (CHI, ATL, ATX)
jobs.description:
***Who we are:***  
bread & Butter is a full-service communications agency with a fondness for all things food, drink and travel. We are a collaborative group of dreamers and do-ers. We combine intimate local knowledge with an extensive national network to craft clever and multidisciplinary communications campaigns tailored to our clients’ needs. We only partner with inventive businesses that inspire us and continually challenge us to think big, but act small.  
  
***Why bread & Butter:***  
We are Southerners at heart, always saying, “Please” and “Thank You,” and hustlers by trade. We believe everyone deserves a seat at the table and practice what we preach to ensure the spirit of hospitality runs through everything we do. We're not a company that wastes time—not yours, not ours. We are not too busy to talk, come by or think of new ways to increase long-term brand awareness. For us, there is little difference between work and pleasure because our work is our pleasure.  
  
***We’re Looking at You!***  
A Digital Marketing Coordinator with bread & Butter is a digital whiz kid, go-getter, and many-hat wearer who is ready to roll up your sleeves and get to work. You can’t get enough digital whether it’s keeping up with the latest email marketing trends or testing new ad strategies. You’re also obsessed with restaurants, wine, food products, destinations and hotels and most likely have been a waiter, front desk clerk, line cook or oenophile in a past life. You are the account dynamo, helping meet client goals by crafting ads and email campaigns. A proverbial eager beaver, you meet or beat deadlines, stay ahead of trends and always look for a new way to skin a cat. You like to go big – because going home isn’t an option. You’re learning to be a problem solver. A Digital Marketing Coordinator for bread & Butter should be thoughtful, creative, possess an almost obsessive attention to detail and is the first to get in the mix when helping means the chance to learn more.
  
  
***Available Opportunity:***  
A Digital Marketing Coordinator is responsible for assisting with administrative duties for day-to-day advertising & digital marketing account management, as well as learning how to strategically build and manage digital ads and email campaigns for clients. Digital Marketing Coordinators work in tandem with Social Media teams and report to the Digital Marketing Director.  
  
***Here’s What We Need:***

* Bachelor's Degree in marketing or related field plus 1+ years of digital marketing and advertising experience.
* Proven experience in digital marketing with focus on Google Ads, Meta Ads cand email marketing.
* Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms and tools, including Google ads manager, Meta business manager, and email marketing platforms (MailChimp, Constant Contact, Klayvio, etc).

* Demonstrate adaptability in the ever-changing digital space and the ability to think like a consumer.

* Can’t be afraid to try new things, take chances, fail and test everything.
* Attention to detail and budgetary restraints.
* Teamwork mentality.

  
***Working Conditions***  
On the whole, this is a hybrid, office-based role. A Digital Marketing Coordinator will spend time in meetings and briefings. Occasional travel might be required for client visits and planning. This position is considered sedentary to light work, and employees are not required to lift or move heavy objects. Although a Coordinator's commitment will tend to be standard office hours, deadlines or the demands of a client may see the Coordinator working nights or weekends to ensure continued success. * Create narrative copy that educates while maintaining a luxe, accessible brand voice.
* Act as editor for Dr. Dayan's content: shaping drafts, tightening arguments, and keeping a consistent editorial voice across every platform and format.

3. Content strategy and planning

* Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar with a consistent, on-brand publishing cadence, built around research themes and educational series.

* Write captions and hooks that capture attention and drive engagement.

* Handle lighting, audio, color grading, motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects.

6. Publishing and platform management

* Post original, on-brand content to TikTok and Instagram daily.
* Post to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Threads as directed by Dr. Dayan and the strategic plan.

**Job Summary**

As Medical Office Operations Coordinator, you’ll keep daily clinic operations organized and responsive. You’ll support patients and staff, coordinate administrative workflows, and help maintain accurate records and sound financial and compliance practices. The goal is to create and maintain clear, well-managed office processes that help patients access care and enable clinical teams to focus on treatment.

* Coordinate scheduling, patient management, medical administrative support, and customer service.
* Maintain medical records and electronic health records (EHR), including workflows in electronic medical record (EMR) systems and patient management software.
* Support medical billing, budgeting, fiscal and financial management, and practice management.
* Supervise and coordinate healthcare staff; communicate clearly with teams and support human resources processes.

This is not a front desk or basic administrative role.

We are looking for someone who can own operational systems, manage billing workflows, support financial tracking, and help streamline the business side of a growing clinical practice.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, numbers, and processes — not just tasks.

You will be responsible for supporting and improving the operational backbone of the practice, including:

* Full calendar and scheduling management across providers
* Insurance verification, billing workflows, claims tracking, and follow-up
* Revenue cycle support and basic financial/operations tracking
* Patient intake systems and documentation flow management
* Managing EHR / practice management systems (end-to-end ownership of workflows)

* Identifying inefficiencies and improving systems and processes

* Excellent written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently without supervision and take full ownership of tasks

**Preferred Experience (Strong Plus)**

* Experience in psychology or outpatient mental health settings
* Familiarity with platforms such as Office Ally, SimplePractice, TheraNest, or similar
* Basic accounting or bookkeeping experience
* Experience in operations, office management, or business support roles
* Exposure to digital systems, automation, or process improvement

**The ideal candidate:**

**About the Role**

Fundraising strategy is only as good as the operations that support it. The Development Operations Coordinator is the backbone of DSCC's development function - the person who ensures that every donor is acknowledged, every gift is recorded accurately, every report is generated on time, and every prospect is tracked through the pipeline.

DSCC is looking for a full time, on-site Development Operations Coordinator who reports to the Development Director. This role is a critical bridge between the donor-facing work of the Director of Development and the organization's financial and compliance functions. The Coordinator's accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail will directly determine the quality of DSCC's donor relationships and the integrity of its fundraising reporting.

**Development Operations Coordinator Responsibilities/Tasks**

* Own and maintain the donor database (Kindful) as the organization's primary source of truth for all development activity - including gift entry, contact records, soft credits, relationship notes, and household linking.
* Generate all development reports on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis - including gift summaries by fund, donor retention analysis, LYBUNT/SYBUNT lists, event participation, grant pipeline status, and board-level dashboards.

* Support the Director of Development with prospect research.
* Track all donor engagement activity in Kindful, including meeting notes, cultivation touchpoints, solicitation outcomes, and stewardship tasks - ensuring the team's institutional memory lives in the system, not in individual inboxes.
* Manage the development calendar in coordination with the Director, including grant deadlines, acknowledgment timelines, campaign schedules, and reporting due dates.
* Support the gift reconciliation process in partnership with the CFO and finance team on a monthly basis.
* Manage event data entry and reconciliation between Give Smart and Kindful during event season, and advocate for technology solutions that reduce manual data transfer.

**Job Benefits**

* $65,000 - $80,000 commensurate with experience and CRM proficiency
* Paid Time Off (10 sick days per year, 10 vacation days after completion of 3 months of continuous service, and 11 paid holidays)
* Health (HMO or PPO) and Dental PPO

* 401K
* Travel Reimbursement
* Professional Development Training
* LGBTQ+ Cultural Competency Training
* Company Sponsored Events

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in nonprofit development operations, donor database management, or a closely related administrative role.
* High proficiency in a CRM platform - Kindful experience strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills; comfort working with data and generating meaningful insights from it.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously without losing accuracy.
* Collaborative and service-oriented - this role exists to support the fundraising team and enable their best work.
* Experience with prospect research tools (Donor Search, iWave, or similar) a plus.

* Strong organizational, communication, research, project management, writing skills, PC pro?cient, and Microsoft software

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Atmosphere TV**

Atmosphere is the leading streaming TV platform built specifically for businesses. Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming waiting rooms, gyms, bars, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 150 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

We’re seeking a Key Account Manager, reporting to the VP of Distribution Partnerships, to grow Atmosphere’s network of bars, restaurants, and other venues across Chicago. You’ll sign new venues from a curated list of high-value targets and make sure our most important existing customers are getting full value from the service.

This is a territory-based role that balances new business with retention, and your success will be measured on both: new customer sign-ups and how well you keep and grow the accounts you already have.

**What you'll do**

* Identify, engage, and sign new bars, restaurants, and other venues in the Chicago territory, working from a curated list of high-value targets.
* Build and maintain relationships with venue owners, managers, and other decision-makers, positioning Atmosphere as a must-have service for their venue.
* Turn signed venues into active partners who collaborate with Atmosphere on campaign executions, product sampling, and deeper integration into their concept.
* Manage a book of high-value existing customers, making sure they’re actively using the service and have it set up to fit their venue.
* Onboard and train new customers, and provide ongoing technical support so their Atmosphere setup runs smoothly.
* Spot opportunities to add value within existing accounts, such as additional screens, locations, or partnership programs.
* Keep track of Chicago hospitality trends, competitors, and new venue openings that could become targets.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly goals for new customer sign-ups, account retention, and revenue growth.
* Partner with marketing, product, and customer support to resolve customer issues and pass along client feedback that informs new features.
* Track and report sales activity, pipeline, and customer engagement metrics in the company’s CRM.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
* Sales experience, ideally selling into hospitality, entertainment, or technology businesses.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including pitching owners and managers face to face.
* Ability to manage a territory independently, plan your own outreach, and hit goals without day-to-day oversight.
* Experience with CRM software (Salesforce preferred) and comfort using pipeline and account data to decide where to spend your time.
* Track record of building long-term relationships with a wide range of clients.
* Ability to build a book of business from a target list and grow it over time.
* Willingness to travel throughout the Chicago territory for in-person client meetings.
* Familiarity with the Chicago bar and restaurant scene is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Base salary $70,000 per year
* On-target earnings $90,000 per year
* Company Equity
* Company 401(k) with employer matching
* Competitive insurance plans
* Flexible Time Off Policy

**Our Commitment to Diversity:**

**Don’t meet every single requirement?** Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet all the criteria. At Atmosphere, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where creativity, innovation, and teamwork thrive. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply—you might be the right fit for this or another role.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Key Accounts
jobs.description:
Our mission at Too Good To Go is to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Too Good To Go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis.

**Core Responsibilities**

As a Key Accounts BDR, you are the engine behind our US expansion. This is not a passive role; you are a strategic hunter and will be tasked with breaking into national brands and large-scale franchises. You will spend 80% of your time on outreach and 20% ensuring our largest partnerships are in a position to expand. This is the definitive proving ground for future sales reps within our Key Accounts sales organization.

Proactive Business Development (80%)

* Strategic Prospecting: Own the end-to-end identification of complex organizations, mapping decision-makers to secure high-value meetings for Key Account reps.
* Discovery: Conduct high-level discovery to qualify partner fit, ensuring we only pursue opportunities with significant impact and scale.
* Diverse Outreach: Execute high-volume outreach via calls, emails, and LinkedIn, moving beyond scripts to sell the value of Too Good To Go to a broad range of clients across multiple departments.

Team Support & Sales Operations (20%)

* Salesforce Management: Own CRM workflows and activity-velocity tracking while following our structured BDM handoff protocols.
* Joint Strategy: Collaborate with Business Development Managers to design and execute tandem sequences, leveraging shared insights to penetrate high-value targets.

**What it takes to succeed**

We are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. Too Good To Go is building a high-performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. If you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.

To succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:

* Choose Excellence over Ease: You take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."
* Demonstrate Integrity and Responsibility: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.
* Seek Honesty: You ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.
* Bring Energy and Joy to the Journey: You take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.

Benefits

Agility & Autonomy

* Modern Hybrid Model: Maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our Chicago hub.
* Global Mobility: The flexibility to work from abroad for up to 30 days per year.
* Dedicated Time to Recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our Shareback program.
* Parental Support: Comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.

Holistic Wellbeing & Security

* Premium Health Coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (EPO), dental, and vision options for employees.
* Comprehensive Support: Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.
* Active Lifestyle: Stay energized with monthly ClassPass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.
* Financial Future: Plan for long-term security with a 401(k) program, including an employer-matched contribution.

Community & Belonging

* Global Connectivity: Engage with our international team through various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), including P.R.I.D.E., Women in the Workplace, Global Majority Voices, and Functionally Diverse groups.
* Vibrant Workspace: Experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.

How to apply

* Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.
* Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

*Certain US states/jurisdictions require Too Good To Go to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the range for new joiners for this role in the United States is a base salary of ~ 70,000 with an OTE of~80,000. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, an individual's assigned work location, experience, and expertise.*

**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for an action-oriented, growth-minded Sales Manager with a proven track record of success to lead our US-based Account Management team. As first line manager, you will coach and develop Account Managers in a horizontal customer segment. You will lead your teams to meet their quota attainment and personal objectives. You will be responsible for developing multiple employees for promotion in this fast growing company.

You will report to our Director of SMB Account Management and work closely with our Account Management leadership team.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage a team of SMB account managers to deliver monthly goal attainment
* Provide leadership and direction to a high-performance team – including hiring, training, and pace setting

* Directly manage and resolve customer escalations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* A minimum 1 year of experience scaling and managing a client-facing sales or account management team in a fast-paced environment
* Previous experience as a top-performing account manager or sales executive
* Proven track record of team quota-attainment via new product sales and upgrades
* Proven leadership skills, people management skills

For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
