jobs.description:
Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 3,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International businesses include market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community. Rakuten Advertising delivers performance-driven, brand-driven, and people-driven ad solutions that help the world’s top brands connect with unique, highly engaged audiences – from first impression to final sale. Backed by industry-leading technology, global media properties, and the largest, high-quality partner network, Rakuten Advertising taps into decades of data and experience to develop the strategies and ad experiences that will drive engagement, sales, loyalty, and beyond. A leader in the industry since its beginnings, Rakuten Advertising is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc. (4755: TOKYO), one of the world’s leading internet service companies. The company is headquartered in San Mateo, California, with offices throughout EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America. Learn more at RakutenAdvertising.com.

**Job Description:**

Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

Rakuten Advertising provides advertising technology and consumer insights to the world’s leading brands and retailers. Working with agencies and brands around the world, Rakuten Advertising unites technology, client strategy and consumer insights to deliver advertising experiences that drive increased brand awareness and  
marketing performance. With access to Rakuten’s diverse media properties and audiences, combined with an award-winning performance network and proprietary consumer research, Rakuten Advertising creates the right conditions to reach new customers and sustain long-lasting loyalty.

**SUMMARY:**

When you’re a part of the Client Services team, as the Account Manager you’ll get exposed to a variety of different brands such as retail, beauty and luxury goods and network with publishers to solidify relationships on behalf of your clients. You will manage the day-to-day execution of their marketing programs and design the overall strategy for growing account revenue. You will leverage your smarts, your client’s brands and Rakuten Advertising’s network to drive results.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee all program implementation by developing and tracking client project plans.
* Interact with clients daily via phone and email for tactical requests.
* Set, meet and exceed aggressive revenue goals for your clients.
* Provide strategic advice to increase each client’s ROI.
* Develop, maintain and extend relationships with your portfolio of clients.
* Organize all activities with the Client Services team and other cross-functional teams at Rakuten Advertising, (Technology, Marketing, Sales, etc.).
* Serve as the guru for Rakuten Advertising’s proprietary software and support your clients to make sure they know the tools and resources available to them.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities):**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* Demonstrated success in measuring results.
* Proof that you can set and surpass KPI targets.
* Analytical and strategic marketing skills.
* The ability to prioritize and strategize based on company’s goals
* A desire to think creatively, solve problems and use professional judgment.
* Tech savvy; comfortable using Excel and PowerPoint for client-facing reports, analysis and presentations.
* Exemplary written and oral presentation and a talent for presenting.

**QUALIFICATION** **REQUIREMENTS:**

* A Bachelor’s Degree.
* 3+ years of online marketing/direct marketing experience with a focus on client service, (it’s a plus if you have knowledge/familiarity with Affiliate Marketing).

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.  
  
**Always improve, Always Advance** - Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen  
**Passionately Professional** - Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best  
**Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika** - Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory  
**Maximize Customer Satisfaction** - The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile  
**Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!** - Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

Start your career journey with Univar Solutions! Here you can make an impact on the world around you and accelerate your career in areas that energize and excite you.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Key Account Manager (KAM) to join our CASE (Coatings, Adhesives, Sealants and Elastomers) team!

The KAM is responsible for building profitable sales for all key national accounts through additional sales with current customers and demonstrates dedication to prospecting and new business development. Employs a sales approach that focuses on building a long-term, value-based relationship with accounts for further business and improving the margin.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Improve Univar Solutions’ position within each assigned account using consultative and in-depth selling at all levels within the account
* Build and implement short, medium and long-term customer growth strategies.
* Using a consultative sales approach, discover new business opportunities and grow Univar Solutions' presence at existing key accounts. Keep detailed records of all activities in Salesforce.
* Provide professional input on complex assignments and projects and provide direction to more junior professionals.
* Responsible for setting pricing and service levels, maintaining and coordinating customer quotations, or providing vital information to allow local branches to do so.
* Responsible for coordinating with Local Sales, Purchasing, and Operations to ensure accurate inventory levels and overall customer satisfaction.

  

**What you’ll need**

* Minimum of 5 years of sales experience managing large corporate accounts in the CASE (raw chemicals) industry.
* Sales experience in manufacturing, distribution, industrial, or chemical industry sales is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred (Technical Science, Chemistry), or equivalent experience.
* Ability as both an effective leader and teammate.
* Deep understanding of business, financials, products/services, the market or the needs/challenges of assigned accounts.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to develop strong, successful business relationships with customers and internal teammates.
* Excellent digital literacy, including MS Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint as well as CRM platforms such as Salesforce.com.
* Strong business insight, including an understanding of the business relationship between manufacturers, distributors, and end-users.
* Effective negotiation skills.

  

**Where you'll work**

This is a **home-based** opportunity — Covering accounts across North America. Preference for candidates locates in the Chicago, IL; Houston, TX and Dublin, OH area.

  

**Pay & Benefits:**

The salary range for this role is USD 84,890 – 127,330. The specific salary offered to a candidate may be motivated by a variety of factors including the candidate’s proven experience, education, training, certifications, qualifications, and work location. Univar Solutions is a leading, global distributor of chemicals and ingredients **essential to the safety, health, and wellbeing of our daily lives** from life-saving medicines and vitamins to hand sanitizers and industrial materials used for cleaning, construction, and more. Our global team of more than **9,500 employees**support our vision to redefine distribution and be the most valued chemical and ingredient distributor on the planet!

Univar Solutions supports **sustainable solutions**for the world around us so that we can do our part to**help keep our communities healthy, fed, clean, and safe!**

  

**We are committed to a diverse workforce and a culture of inclusion.** Together, we are building a culture that acknowledges the unique experiences, perspectives and expertise of individuals and provides the development and growth opportunities to empower us to redefine our industry.

jobs.title: Account Manager - National Accounts
jobs.description:
***We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies. Resumes submitted without prior approval from our Talent Acquisition team will not be eligible for placement fees.***

**Company Overview**

At Fortis Fire & Safety, we provide industry-leading fire protection & security services across the United States. Our ever-growing footprint can be seen in California, Florida, North Carolina, and Chicago, and we are acquiring new brands all the time.

We are proud to work together as one team under the Fortis Fire & Safety family, which includes CJ Suppression, Diversified Systems, Inc., Integrated Fire & Security Solutions, LaMarco Systems, LifeSafety Management, Piper Fire Protection, and VFS Fire & Security Services. United by a shared mission, we deliver comprehensive fire protection and security solutions nationwide.

Joining Fortis means becoming part of a nationwide, next-generation fire protection company. We're dedicated to a People-First philosophy, where we invest in our team through training and development, as well as a competitive benefits package. In return, we expect the very best from each of our employees every day.

If you are ready to be exceptional in your chosen career, apply to work with us today!

Here at Fortis and throughout our family of brands, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Paid vacation and sick time
* Company Paid Holidays
* Additional paid time off for life events (e.g., jury duty, bereavement)
* Competitive compensation
* 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Short-term/Long-term disability insurance
* Life Insurance
* Career Advancement Opportunities and more!

*\*\*This is a general overview of benefits. Specific eligibility and coverage details will be provided during the hiring process\*\**

**Job Summary:**

Fortis Fire & Safety is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused **Account Manager - National Accounts** to join our National Accounts team based at our headquarters in Schaumburg, IL. This role is responsible for managing and growing relationships with multi-site and national commercial customers while identifying opportunities to expand Fortis' services across customer portfolios.

The Account Manager serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service, operational coordination, contract retention, and long-term account growth. This position works closely with facilities leaders, property managers, portfolio owners, and corporate stakeholders across commercial real estate, healthcare, education, logistics, industrial, and other multi-location environments.

While a strong relationship-management mindset is critical, successful candidates will also demonstrate the ability to develop new business opportunities through existing customer relationships, referrals, industry connections, prospecting, and strategic outreach. **About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.

Valar is hiring across all orgs and the volume keeps climbing. We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to carry live searches from week one: scheduling interviews, hosting candidates onsite, managing travel, and keeping Greenhouse accurate across every pipeline in flight. Our coordination team already runs a working process, built for a smaller company than the one we're becoming. You'll step into it, then improve it. Role:

**About the Role**

Great marketing is more than a compelling message. It's about reaching the right people, at the right time, with solutions that make a difference in their lives.

At Southland Credit Union, we're looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager who can turn big ideas into meaningful results. In this role, you'll help shape how we attract new Members, strengthen existing relationships, and connect people with financial products and services that support their goals.

Working closely with the VP of Marketing, you'll play a key role in shaping campaign strategy and driving initiatives from initial concept through execution and performance evaluation. This is a role for someone who can see the bigger picture, recognize opportunities, bring forward recommendations, and take ownership of turning strategy into measurable results.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Turning Marketing Strategy Into Action**

Every successful campaign starts with understanding who you're trying to reach, what matters to them, and what you want to accomplish. As the Integrated Marketing Manager, you'll translate organizational priorities into thoughtful marketing strategies that connect the right audiences with the right messages.

You won't simply be executing campaigns that have already been defined. You'll help determine the approach—identifying opportunities, understanding target audiences, shaping messaging, selecting the right channels, and establishing how success will be measured.

You'll lead integrated campaigns across digital advertising, email, websites, social media, direct mail, Financial Center communications, and other marketing channels. By bringing together creative development, compelling storytelling, digital marketing, and audience insights, you'll ensure each campaign delivers a cohesive experience and supports Southland's broader business objectives.

You'll also look for ways to make marketing more relevant and effective through audience segmentation, personalization, testing, and optimization. Your ability to connect business priorities with Member insights and marketing performance will help guide decisions and shape stronger campaigns.

**Driving Campaigns and Cross-Functional Partnerships**

Strong marketing requires more than a good strategy. It takes someone who can bring the right people together, influence direction, and move initiatives forward.

You'll serve as a key Marketing partner to departments including Lending, Operations, Digital Banking, and Member Experience. By understanding their priorities and challenges, you'll identify opportunities to translate business needs into marketing initiatives that attract new Members, encourage product adoption, deepen existing relationships, and support Member engagement.

You'll lead campaign planning and coordination across internal teams, marketing specialists, and external vendors. From developing campaign briefs and providing creative direction to managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder feedback, you'll maintain ownership of the work while keeping everyone aligned on the desired outcomes.

This role calls for someone who can confidently make recommendations, exercise sound judgment, and address challenges without waiting for direction at every step. When priorities shift or obstacles arise, you'll identify solutions, manage competing demands, and keep initiatives moving forward.

**Measuring Results and Improving Performance**

Great marketing doesn't end when a campaign launches. Understanding what worked, what didn't, and where opportunities exist is just as important as the strategy behind it.

You'll monitor campaign performance against established objectives and key performance indicators, using marketing analytics, behavioral data, and audience insights to evaluate effectiveness. You'll translate those findings into meaningful recommendations that help improve acquisition, Member engagement, product adoption, and retention.

You'll also oversee campaign budgets, monitor expenditures, and recommend adjustments based on performance and business priorities. Working with Compliance and other stakeholders, you'll coordinate required reviews and approvals to ensure campaigns align with Southland's brand standards, messaging guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Success means serving as a trusted marketing partner who can independently lead initiatives, influence campaign direction, anticipate challenges, and deliver results. You'll know how to balance the bigger strategic picture with the details required to bring each campaign to life, while continuously looking for ways to improve performance and strengthen Member relationships.

Knowledge and Skills:

**Experience**

* Five or more years of progressive marketing experience, including demonstrated responsibility for developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Proven ability to independently lead complex, multichannel marketing initiatives from planning through execution and performance evaluation.
* Strong copywriting, editing, and storytelling skills, with experience developing clear, compelling marketing content across digital and traditional channels.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple project timelines, and driving accountability without direct supervisory authority.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, customer acquisition, lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, and campaign performance measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret marketing performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Experience presenting recommendations and collaborating with stakeholders at various organizational levels.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Design, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Visual Communications, or a related field preferred.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Production Coordinator to monitor production orders, coordinate schedules, and ensure timely delivery of customer orders. This position works closely with Production, Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Management to track job progress, resolve scheduling issues, and maintain efficient production flow.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication and organizational skills, experience in a manufacturing environment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor production orders and work-in-progress (WIP) to ensure jobs move through manufacturing on schedule.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate daily and weekly production schedules.
* Track job status, identify production delays, and coordinate corrective actions to meet delivery commitments.
* Work with Production, Purchasing, Engineering, and other departments to resolve scheduling conflicts, material shortages, and production issues.
* Expedite priority orders and communicate job status, schedule changes, and delivery updates.
* Participate in production meetings and provide updates on job progress, capacity constraints, and scheduling concerns.
* Maintain accurate production schedules, job information, and status updates in ERP/MRP systems.
* Monitor shipments and communicate potential delays or revised delivery dates to Sales.
* Prepare and review production reports, including backlog, WIP, shipments, and on-time delivery performance.
* Support continuous improvement efforts to improve production flow and scheduling efficiency.
* Assist with production and material handling activities as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in production coordination, scheduling, manufacturing, customer service, or a related role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Experience using ERP, MRP, or production planning systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple departments in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in PCB manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, or a related production environment.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, capacity planning, material flow, and inventory coordination.
* Experience tracking work-in-progress (WIP), production performance, and delivery schedules.
* Familiarity with manufacturing reports, order management, and production forecasting.

**Work EnvironmentPhysical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based in a manufacturing environment.
* Regular computer use, phone communication, and walking through production areas.
* May occasionally lift up to 15 pounds.
* Ability to attend onsite meetings and occasional business-related travel as needed.

new_jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable, unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

**The Role**

Valar is hiring across all orgs and the volume keeps climbing. We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to carry live searches from week one: scheduling interviews, hosting candidates onsite, managing travel, and keeping Greenhouse accurate across every pipeline in flight. Our coordination team already runs a working process, built for a smaller company than the one we're becoming. You'll step into it, then improve it. Competing calendars, late cancellations, and shifting priorities are the normal condition here, and you'll be trusted to resolve most of it yourself. Candidates meet Valar through you first.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own interview scheduling across teams, time zones, and sites, including the multi-panel days.
* Host candidates onsite and run the day so interviewers and candidates always know where they stand.
* Coordinate candidate travel and review the expenses
* Own Greenhouse data hygiene: stage accuracy, interview kits, scorecard completion, clean candidate records.
* Close the gap between offer accepted and first day: background checks, paperwork, and the handoff to People Operations.
* Resolve scheduling conflicts on your own judgment, bringing recruiters and hiring managers the tradeoff and your recommendation rather than the raw problem.
* Keep pipelines moving with recruiters and hiring managers, flagging stalled candidates and interviewer bottlenecks before a search goes cold.
* Learn what we build and who we hire well enough to answer a candidate's questions yourself.
* Improve the coordination process as you learn it: bring the problem, the proposed fix, then the implementation.
* Pitch in on whatever hiring needs most that week, no matter the title on it, no task here is too small when a candidate or a deadline is on the line.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA - 5 days onsite

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

new_jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers.** Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
* **Drive activation yourself.** Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
* **Automate your own work.** Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
* **Spend your time on strategic conversations.** Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
* **Spot who is ready for more.** Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
* **Build programs, not one-offs.** When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
* **Be the voice of your book.** Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

**Where your time goes as we automate**
---------------------------------------

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

* **Deeper with priority accounts.** Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
* **Quarterly launches.** Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
* **Events.** Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
* **New signups and scaled partnerships.** Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
* Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around
* Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly
* Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track
* Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization
* Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win
* Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it
* Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely

**Strong candidates may also**
------------------------------

* Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup
* Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types
* Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts
* Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations
* Understand how nonprofits

**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.

* You know why you're calling an account, and who owns the problem, before you pick up the phone.

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support for the WINGS+++ study in Orange County, NY, including coordinating recruitment and data collection, and will serve as liaison to community partners.

WINGS+++ is a NIDA-funded study (R61/R33) within the Social Intervention Group (SIG) at the Columbia University School of Social Work. The study is developing and testing an mHealth intervention with peer navigation for women in Orange County, New York, who use opioids or other drugs and who are affected by intimate partner violence (IPV) and trauma. The WINGS+++ intervention includes three self-paced mHealth sessions that screen for and address opioid and other substance use, IPV, and post-traumatic stress, combined with peer navigation that links women to medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and other substance use treatment, IPV, mental health, and social services. The study is conducted in close partnership with Orange County community organizations and includes a pilot trial. Under the direction of and reporting to the Project Director, the Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support to study research and administrative needs.

Working directly with and reporting to the Project Director, the Program Coordinator will:

* Coordinate day-to-day study operations and administrative needs in Orange County.
* Serve as the liaison between Orange County community partners and the study team.
* Schedule participants and support baseline and follow-up assessments.
* Coordinate participant recruitment and retention through the 12-month follow-up.
* Manage study petty cash & reimbursements, maintain records, schedules, and reports.
* Represent the study at community events and presentations to build awareness.
* Candidates who live in or have strong ties to Orange County, NY, are strongly preferred.

***THIS POSITION IS GRANT-FUNDED. CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT IS CONTINGENT ON FUNDING AVAILABILITY.***

* Performs related duties and responsibilities as assigned/requested.

----------------

We're looking for a strategic, creative Content Marketing Manager who knows how to build content that builds community. This isn't a role for someone who just wants to write blogs. We're looking for someone who thinks deeply about how content shapes trust, drives discovery, and turns our audience into loyal advocates. You'll own our content strategy end-to-end: building the content engine that powers our external presence and supports teams across the company, leading brand campaigns, managing our Content Marketing Coordinator, and growing the community of pros who rely on Topline Pro to run and grow their businesses. If you love building systems as much as you love crafting content that resonates with real people, and you have the portfolio to prove it, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own content strategy and the editorial calendar across website, email, social, YouTube, and community.
* Build a repeatable content engine that powers our external presence and supports cross-functional teams (sales collateral, product marketing, enablement, etc).
* Manage the Content Marketing Coordinator, setting direction while they support production and editing.
* Own our content library (DAM) so every team can easily find and use the right assets.
* Lead one-off brand campaigns, from seasonal pushes to announcements.
* Create content that speaks authentically to home service pros (roofers, landscapers, painters, cleaners) and feels uniquely Topline Pro.
* Produce a range of formats: case studies, how-to guides, video scripts, testimonials, social friendly, and long-form.
* Collect interviews oof pros and turn their stories into content that builds trust and drives organic growth.
* Use content to fuel and support growth of an engaged pro community through forums, Facebook groups, newsletters, and events.
* Build a thought leadership program for Topline Pro and key internal voices via articles, podcasts, speaking, and LinkedIn.
* Cultivate relationships with pro advocates and industry experts who amplify our brand.
* Partner with Performance Marketing to create content for paid ads.
* Develop and own a repeatable playbook for distributing content that drives sales through SEO/GEO/AEO.
* Act as a player / coach with the ability to drive direction while being comfortable jumping in to execute when needed.
* Track performance, iterate fast, and scale what resonates.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4-5 years of experience in content marketing, brand storytelling, or editorial — with a portfolio that shows range and craft.
* Experience managing and developing at least one direct report, including setting priorities and giving clear creative direction.
* Proven ability to develop content strategy, not just execute on it — you know how to build a plan, and the systems behind it, from scratch.
* Experience leading integrated brand campaigns from concept through launch.
* Experience building or scaling a brand community — online groups, newsletters, ambassador or advocate programs, live or virtual events.
* Track record developing thought leadership content: executive ghostwriting, contributed articles, podcast or speaking program management, or LinkedIn brand building.
* Strong writing and editing skills across formats: short-form social, long-form guides, video scripts, email sequences.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, AI Products - MCP Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Hybrid: New York, NY (2-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square.

**SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS**
-------------------------------------------------------

Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.

As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections.

This is a category-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who wants to be on the ground floor of defining what success looks like for the companies adopting it.

**THE ROLE**
------------

As our Customer Success Manager, you will own the full post-sale relationship with MCP Manager customers: onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion. Our customers are typically companies of 200 to 1,000+ employees with active AI initiatives, and the people you work with day to day include VPs of AI, CTOs, IT operations leaders, and security teams. You will be the person who makes sure every one of them gets real, measurable value from putting their AI agent connections under governance.

You will work hand in hand with our Account Executives and Sales Engineer, and closely with our product, engineering, design, and marketing teams, inside a small, fast-moving group that operates much like a startup within Usercentrics. The role exists now because our customer base is growing and customer success deserves a dedicated owner. You will build the processes, health signals, and playbooks that let us scale it, and your insight from customers will directly shape what we build next.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

### **Onboarding and Adoption**

* Take over new customers at handoff after signing, building on the proof of concept and documented initial configuration they completed with our Account Executive and Sales Engineer, and guide them to broad rollout across their teams.
* Refine the success criteria agreed during the sales process into a success plan for each customer that ties their use of MCP Manager to the outcomes they care about, such as visibility, security, and cost control.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they are getting and where they can go next.
* Bring in our Sales Engineer when customers need deeper help with technical configuration or troubleshooting.

### **Support and Customer Health**

* Respond to inbound support requests through chat and email within our response-time targets.
* Route technical issues to our Sales Engineer, and to engineering when needed, with clear context and reproduction steps, and keep customers informed until they are resolved.
* Build and maintain a customer health score that draws on product usage, engagement, and support history.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and lead proactive outreach before small issues become churn.

### **Renewals, Expansion, and Billing**

* Own renewals for your book of customers and forecast them accurately.
* Identify expansion opportunities, such as additional teams, servers, or plan upgrades, and drive them to close in partnership with our Account Executives.
* Process plan upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in our billing and CRM systems so that customer records stay accurate.

### **Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and categorize customer feedback, and work with our Product Manager so that product and engineering can prioritize with real data.
* Close the loop with customers when features they requested ship or issues they reported are fixed.
* Build our customer advocacy program with marketing, collecting reviews, references, and case studies.
* Document repeatable processes and playbooks so that customer success can scale as we grow.

  
**Requirements**  

* You have 3 or more years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.
* You have owned renewals for a book of business and have a track record of retaining customers and growing accounts.
* You are technically fluent: you can explain how software products connect to each other, run a confident product walkthrough, and work through configuration questions alongside technical colleagues.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person with audiences ranging from hands-on administrators to CTOs and security leaders.
* You are highly organized and can manage many accounts, support requests, and internal projects at once without letting details slip.
* You use AI assistants and agents in your own work and are curious about how companies are adopting them.
* You are comfortable operating in an early-stage, category-creation environment where the playbook is still being written.
* Ideally, you have worked with customers in security, developer tools, data infrastructure, or AI software, or have hands-on familiarity with AI agents or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ideally, you have built customer health scoring, onboarding programs, or other customer success processes from scratch.

  
**Benefits**  

* 401(k) plan contribution with employer match
* Commuter allowance (transit stipend)
* 18 paid vacation days (PTO)
* Health insurance
* Personal development budget for every employee
* Hybrid workplace
* Online wellness sessi

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. As a key member of our marketing team, you'll build the campaign frameworks and cross-channel motions that connect our content, events, digital programs, and account-based efforts into cohesive journeys that move buyers from awareness to activation.

* Move the first priority program into execution with aligned stakeholders, ownership, timelines, and measurement.

**Compensation and Benefits**

new_jobs.title: National Sales Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Brayden, co-founder of Sola. We’re a venture-backed insurance startup based in Atlanta, and we’re hiring a National Account Manager to help grow our largest agency partnerships.

Most insurance companies have spent decades building complicated products and equally complicated ways to sell them. We’re doing things differently. We started with wind and hail coverage, using weather data to make claims faster, simpler, and more transparent. We’ve grown to 8-figure revenue and partnered with thousands of independent insurance agencies along the way.

Now we’re focused on going deeper with our largest partners. Some of the biggest opportunities at Sola aren’t new relationships. They’re the agencies already doing business with us that have hundreds of producers, multiple offices, and significant room to grow.

You’ll own a named portfolio of our most important national and regional accounts, with the opportunity to build relationships, expand our footprint, and influence how Sola grows across the country.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR Checklist**
-------------------

**✓** In person. West Midtown Atlanta office with skyline views, daily catering, and snacks

**✓** Startup environment. Small team, meaningful equity, and room to grow

**✓** Hypergrowth. 300%+ growth since May, 8-figure revenue

**✓** National accounts. Own a named portfolio of Sola’s largest agency partnerships

**✓** Real ownership. Build account strategies, expand relationships, and directly influence revenue

**✓** Flat structure. Work directly with our Director of Sales, Insurance, and leadership team

**About the Role**
------------------

* You’ll own and grow a defined portfolio of Sola’s largest national and regional agency partners. These are complex relationships that often span multiple offices, states, and decision-makers.
* Your job is to turn existing partnerships into meaningful, long-term revenue and hunt for new partnership opportunities with groups we are not yet partnered with. That means building relationships with agency leadership, identifying opportunities to expand into new offices and markets, and getting more producers actively selling Sola.
* You’ll work closely with our Sales and Insurance teams to develop account strategies, introduce new products, and help our partners grow alongside us.
* We’re looking for someone who understands how large agencies operate and knows how to turn a strong relationship into broader adoption across an organization.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own national accounts. Manage a named portfolio of large agency partners, with responsibility for revenue growth, retention, and overall account performance.
* Expand existing relationships. Identify opportunities to grow across additional offices, regions, and producer networks.
* Build strategic account plans. Develop growth strategies for each partner, set measurable goals, and execute against them.
* Drive adoption. Work with agency leadership and individual producers to make Sola a consistent part of their sales process.
* Navigate complex organizations. Build relationships with executives, regional leaders, territory managers, directors, and producers across multiple markets.
* Know your accounts. Understand agency operations, competitive offerings, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and solve problems.
* Work across teams. Partner with Sales, Insurance, and Product to introduce new programs, support agency needs, and grow existing business.

**Must-haves**

* 7+ years in sales, account management, insurance distribution, or a related field.
* Property and Casualty Insurance tenure
* Strategic account management. You’ve managed large, complex relationships and know how to grow revenue within existing accounts.
* Relationship builder.You’re comfortable working with senior executives and individual producers alike.
* Growth focused. You can identify opportunities, build a plan, and turn that plan into measurable results.
* Organized. You can manage multiple accounts, competing priorities, and long-term initiatives without losing track of the details.
* Strong communicator. You can influence decisions, navigate difficult conversations, and build trust with partners.
* In person. You’re excited to work with our team in West Midtown Atlanta.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Agency networks. Experience working with large independent agencies, national brokerages, aggregators, or agency networks.
* Multi-location growth. You’ve expanded accounts across multiple branches, territories, or states.

**Benefits**
------------

* Early stage equity
* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you, your spouse, and your children
* Daily catered lunch
* 401(k)
* Paid parking
* One Medical membership

new_jobs.title: Route Sales & Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Sales & Account Manager in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Benefits: Dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, mileage reimbursement, paid time off, vision insurance

Schedule: Monday to Friday; weekend availability as needed

Supplemental Pay: Commission pay, bonus pay

Ability to commute/relocate: Atlanta, GA

Experience: Route sales or territory sales: 1 year (Required); Account management: 1 year (Preferred); B2B sales or staffing industry: 1 year (Preferred)

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

**POSITION TITLE:** Community Manager

**DEPARTMENT:** Resident Services

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Manager

**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt

**JOB SUMMARY:**The Community Manager is a business leader who focuses on resident customer service and manages operations, leasing activity, renewals, collections, financial reporting, supplies, and communications for an assigned residential community.

**VALUES MODELED:** All employees are expected to find ways to bring our values to life every day by demonstrating: leadership, commitment, and integrity.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:** Resident feedback on quality and timeliness of resident services provided; resident turnover.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Manage day-to-day leasing operations.**
  + Inspect community on a regular basis and verifies the condition of vacant units in order to minimize rental arrears.
  + Manage daily community requirements and maintains long-range capital improvements planning.
  + Ensure all monies received are deposited and recorded on a daily basis and confirms proper bookkeeping procedures are followed.
  + Compile weekly/monthly community status reports.
  + Promptly respond to resident concerns, comments, and/or complaints.
  + Ensure that the proper move-in paperwork, keys, and remotes are prepared for a new resident.
  + Operate the office in a professional, clean, uncluttered, and well-staffed manner.
  + Inspect make-ready apartments prior to move in.
  + Enforce occupancy policies and procedures.
  + Maintain and/or create a resident renewal program to encourage resident retention.
  + Create a sense of community at the community while maintaining the policy of non-fraternization.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.
* **Manage community maintenance with the assistance of the service team.**
  + Organize incoming and outgoing inspections and prepare inspection reports.
  + Implement preventive maintenance programs.
  + Oversee improvement projects.
  + Manage requests for repairs and maintenance and evaluates timely completion of work orders.
  + Maintain compliance with required permits for operating the community, such as, pool, elevator, etc.
  + Monitor electric, water, and gas usage on the community.
* **Maintains and manages all financial responsibilities.**
  + Approve and submit invoices for payment in a timely manner.
  + Maintain accurate records of community transactions and submits on timely basis (i.e., rent rolls, delinquency reports, move-in/move-outs, etc.).
  + Complete variance reports and other weekly reports.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.

* **Manages and monitors rental collection.**
  + Ensure rent and other charges are collected timely and posted daily.
  + Ensure the proper legal notices are given and deadlines met concerning filing eviction, filing writs, and attending court hearings.
  + Ensure compliance with community policies and lease agreements. Responds to violations and communicates with the residents.
  + Assess move-out condition of apartments and has a final account statement sent with the final disposition.
  + Immediately inform and refer any liability claims, legal complaints, or other violations to the Regional Manager and/or corporate office.
* **Manages community personnel.**
  + Hire, train, and evaluate community staff.
  + Create, mentor, and manage a cohesive community management team in accordance with policies.
  + Coordinate orientation and ongoing training programs for community staff.
  + Complete performance reviews for staff and makes recommendations for salary increases and/or advancement.
  + Direct and control all personnel and resources to ensure the community is properly maintained and meets owner objectives.
  + Manage time off for community management team and submit payroll for processing.
  + Ensure staff receives new hire safety orientation as well as annual safety training.
  + Coordinate with the Service Manager and attend monthly safety meetings and training for community staff; monitor the use of proper safety precautions on the community.
  + Follow company procedures and reports any workers' compensation issues and/or employee incidents immediately to the workers' compensation carrier, to management, and to Employee Service Department.
* **Manages, creates and monitors marketing activities.**
  + Understand the market and any other aspects of the sub-market that could impact occupancy and/or income of the community.

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Property Type: Garden**

**Stage: Stabilized**

**Unit Count: 240**

**Schedule: Monday-Friday + rotating weekends Job Requirements:**

Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.  

* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.

**Region:** Chicago, US – Midwest Region

**About Vos Collection**

Vos Collection is a network of North America's premier medical aesthetics clinics, bringing together 32 distinct clinic brands under a unified vision of elevated patient care and premium brand experiences. We are building a category-defining aesthetic brand, one that combines the intimacy and expertise of individual clinic identities with the scale and ambition of an industry-leading brand.

We believe that world-class patient experiences, high clinical standards, and modern marketing capabilities belong together. We are building the infrastructure, the brand, and the team to make that real.

**The role**

Vos Collection is seeking a research-minded writer and content creator to join our growing team as a full-time Social Media Specialist. This role sits at the intersection of science, storytelling, and social media. Your core job is to research, write, and develop content that builds and protects the professional reputation of one of the most respected voices in facial aesthetics.

If you can read a peer-reviewed study, find the story in it, and turn it into a script, an article, and a Reel that people actually want to watch, we want to hear from you. A background in journalism, publishing, or editorial work, paired with hands-on social media experience, is ideal.

**Working with Dr. Dayan**

You will work directly with Dr. Dayan, a facial plastic surgeon in Chicago whose career spans surgery, academia, and publishing. He is a New York Times and USA TODAY bestselling author, with over 180 published journal articles and six books.

Your mission is to establish Dr. Dayan as the authoritative "Science of Attraction" expert: translating rigorous science into content that is compelling, accessible, accurate, and unmistakably luxe. new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
new_jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.
* Ability to research accounts and understand buyer personas and decision-making structures.
* Curiosity about how data platforms and AI work, and the drive to learn the technology well enough to discuss it with an engineer.
* Strong client-facing presence and clear, concise writing.
* Bonus: Experience in or selling into healthcare, life sciences, financial services or insurance.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

This role is designed for BDRs who build their own pipeline today and are growing toward owning accounts and closing deals.
